{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柳、星、張三宿在位，午作太阴為妾，午加酉為婢，午加辰老婦。","logicSentenceId":"7679104346826997770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午加日辰行年上為屋，午加申酉，庚辛日上笄妻，午加辰戌，為半路。","logicSentenceId":"7679104346827014154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午桒六合加太常衣服，午加亥卯未為荳，午加寅卯，主宅。","logicSentenceId":"7679104346827030538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛加午疲病。","logicSentenceId":"7679104346827046922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午乗蛇加日辰，兒童発驚；午加卯酉，交占股病。","logicSentenceId":"7679104346827063306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531198252761126"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午加魁罡，主信至。","logicSentenceId":"7679104346827079690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作蛇雀丙丁曰交，冬逢燒衣。","logicSentenceId":"7679104346827096074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小吉属未，其数八味甘。","logicSentenceId":"7679104346827112458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦将神射覆法第六卷六壬入易，乾河魁登明主之。内赤外白，内方外圓，逄火即輭，遇水即堅，上有文字，繩索相連，聚而□寔，散而不全，細想是卦，無過是錢。仰如鏤鼎，萇如鐘懸，若非金鉄，即是銅鉛，團圓外實，裡。畔虗空，人見敬貴，能鑒身容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531493108121600"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎神后主之。坎性承風，依近水中。不浮南北，又役西東。有形不動，落亦無蹤。騰浮方物，便似飄蓬。悠悠之物，外黄内黑。性樂潛蔵，情同𨼆匿，長在家居。唯能野合，去即被撫，逄主不□。艮大吉功曹主之。艮背之形，不動其聲，内虗外寔，團圓所成。王相則寔，死氣則虗。木能生火，能豈亭亭。人警響合，形如覆盆。春秋不改，積世長存。此物團圓，内𮓡外慳，能屈不動，種","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生。若非青白，即是龜絞。震太冲主之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震物動停，内白外青，頭圓尾小，将变其形。震上变動，身無空形。𭭾生復死，織絡成經。如蚕作繭，似獸熊身。能盛能壮，波团能圆。逐时变改，色體蒼然。下不着地，上不侵天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531466474307625"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非果實，即是魚筌。巽天罡太乙主之。巽凛風雲，鄷炁氤氲，聲添音韻，逺聴時闻。乍吟乍哭，時聚時群。形如綵蜨，影似青蘋。棄主為形，光彩金生，游行影照，䋲索之刑。空中隐伏，袤寔茲成，神歌鬼笑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"響大空声。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離勝光主之，似龍無角，如馬頭訛。若非牝馬，即是驢驘。人頭即少，离體身多。不臨溪谷，即近長波。先白後赤，水上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"員。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藏。彫形鱗彩，内柔外剛。外頭雖實，裏畔虗張。賊人盗得，灰土埋藏。坤小吉傳送主之。坤體外黄，其色内蒼。水土而实，内圓外方。形如瓦礫，堅復能刚。若非古器，即是槖囊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦体名坤，土性长存。朝依","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野，暮宿孤村。若非牝馬，即是其犉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"惇，牛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531345057693711"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兑從魁主之。兑為金錢，堅硬裁截，乍剛乍桑，有時屈折。内裡光彩，外能圓缺。若非連珠，衣茄帶玦。兑性居平，外缺内明，形依净域。炫耀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"光生遥承安殿，似佛因荣。若非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"銅鐵，即是金銀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼撮卷六脚終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干旺相死休囚法卷之七甲乙日春同旺，木青相火黄，死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土黑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金紅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休水白。丙丁日夏同，火紅土白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金青水黄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木黑；戊巳日四季 {"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若问舟車有遺亡，之如𠒇孫细評详。卯加巳上地户當，但言丑日信无","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妨","logicSentenceId":"7679097735199768616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"剋應不須死墓推，類应本神日上知。如问文書午上宜，上神降下的無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉類妻獰并信息，太隂乗酉三妻偪。財旺妻𩀌鏡分劈，加午議親子淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"佚。","logicSentenceId":"7679097735199768616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"迯亾奴婢天空啚，𫝊𣱙為婢传陽奴。天空加支事最殊，信至人歸有𫠦需。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有人失物问猫見，便将天上功曺推。","logicSentenceId":"7679097735199785000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨支不捕自帰来，臨","logicSentenceId":"7679097735199801384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"干。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物","logicSentenceId":"7679097735199801384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531563824054326"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不離人時","logicSentenceId":"7679097735199801384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬日失犬，戍加壬，次日尋囬，不離人。各類如此，准擬尋㦯投隣家淂信音。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六畜灾屯問太冲，上来子己酉申同。刀砧湯火屠殺㐫，餘将臨来皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可容","logicSentenceId":"7679097735199817768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄弟太𣱙父太常，只看本類落何方。刑害死炁及空亡，地上類下尅应","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679097735199817768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"梯子燈擎并衣架，折𠯁桌面𠔥牀下。𥁞從邜字作加臨，端的言来寔希詫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"每日两个天目鬼，四旹居重辰上二，来剋干上便是祟，以類言","logicSentenceId":"7679097735199834152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531493112217600"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之無差異。","logicSentenceId":"7679097735199834152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

IdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自亥必散，一辰忙日之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未戌，","logicSentenceId":"7679098747913256994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六甲之日六合初，上逼下迫自相拘，風氣不順病末除，被人煎逼不伸舒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531407053668386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六癸午椉天后武，心血不寕事多阻。不肰堂上尊長苦，年𠇮逄之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心栩栩，","logicSentenceId":"7679098747913256994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三传传逆要更圗，自家進退不伸舒。公人退職官退居，進寸退尺不能無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三传传逆望行人，行人不日便相親。若逢天耳有信音，信到人来决㝎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真","logicSentenceId":"7679098747913256994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命上見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" 94","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占産不要見三合，三合時日必蹉跎。两姓外家生者多，不然𬨨月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎平和","logicSentenceId":"7679098747913256994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531459591520283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占產不要逆連珠，孩兒不順母傷軀。三传传順遲有餘，吉神吉将少驚虞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孕母行年上見陽，生男必㝎有威光。隂将元来生女子，阴阳反覆命難長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三朝四日不能生，但看十二支干辰。天目鬼来剋母身，為祻爲崇各區","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分","logicSentenceId":"7679098747913256994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午堂丑房邜酉门，天目鬼来相步行。若更傳中有𬮦神，看其等䖏作灾迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天目鬼與阿谁并，七宝灘中神勿論。祟旤求除即便生，免淂爹孃憂与。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"音。","logicSentenceId":"7679098747913256994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一例陳㫁課，從來災福真𠑶令占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"失鵞未可問，子必塘池。又河魁但问小吉落何支，𢦙在空亡左右推，𢦙臨亥一首失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邜酉对靣及四隣，心鏡推说占","logicSentenceId":"7679098747913273378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7679098747913273378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"句。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真","logicSentenceId":"7679098747913273378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"使者行衙来按巡，來与不來问貴人。臨辰便到在逡巡，不來還是隔三辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"課中總不畏蒿矢，蒿矢有金血光起。三传申酉地上是，公文喫棒应無理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531493112315904"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"彈射有丸傷痛楚，占病死人傷命苦。辰戌丑未四丸所，此體死人知㡬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許","logicSentenceId":"7679098747913273378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占病老人與小囝，逢此二體是逡廵。一弹一射俱不任，须知性命速歸隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"斬関湏是有金氣，乕陰申酉分明記。若有青龍逃者逰，無龍争官多獲辠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三傳俱是日之財，丙丁從革做金裁。求財未遂先見乖，財多害己父母灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三传俱是日干類，湏防兄弟相連累。𬨨房隨娘并義兒，有憂疑慮心下記。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531407053717538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三传俱是曰之鬼，庚辛炎上圗名遂，否極泰来更改至。","logicSentenceId":"7679098747913273378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大宜從","logicSentenceId":"7679098747913289762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官有祿位，","logicSentenceId":"7679098747913289762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"贵人等帯二馬乘財者，隔州路出外之財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年財臨嵗月，主纒。龍蛇營運及粧奩。玄僧虎孝屠公吏，雀眷勾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"令關田園。玄僧道之財，虎孝家公吏屠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯占早近卯陽臨，阴局須遲逺處音。二月中氣分离叓，酉居八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月反兹尋。卯居陽局，主早信易朝信也。卯日门邜臨陰局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主晚信并遲。在春分時占得，主分离信。酉临陽局，主暗逺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"信并遲。信臨隂局，主早近明信。在龜分占主分離信","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知丹詔發京華。传内𡻕君月将查，天馬一処併交加，此為天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子信無差","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531558073647104"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路在空亡敗墓郷，家神剋路之神亡。行年白乕会今曰，便是歸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"期不用詳。行年白虎二神合日即歸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"游神加孟尚遲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之，仲季加之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不久歸；貴人加日至不疑，天罡加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"季不移時。逰神春巳夏子，秋酉冬，辰加孟未至，加仲季不乆至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎加臨在戌宫，用神卯酉亥相逢，㝎須即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觧帰驄。二馬臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓占一同，若是音信尚未通。朱雀之隂問来踪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬主即到丁卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰时夘時辰加夘為用，上見虎，又天馬剋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日上，當是巳時归。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531558073663488"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行踰千里貴前尋，倍此还須数後程。前玄後㱕两般論，彼此原","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"来第五辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近行龍路月為家，路剋家回家尅賖。返吟為用，月復加望人立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至㝎无差。乗神家剋路未回，是太隂克青龍所乘神。返吟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為用，太陰加，立至返吟時，占行人多不来，雖是二馬传墓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不来。返吟日為用，与","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建相命立至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲将所孕卜氤氜，先看発用在何方，一二貴前主弄璋，四三贵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後细消詳。用在第一二課，又在天乙前，是男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用在三四課，又乙後是女。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰人年見陰女占，那堪传送復加年。三传俱隂女不想，纯是陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時男有縁。行年上則陰是女，阳是男，三传俱陽生男，俱阴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531541577498678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生女。假令用在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之旺在卯上，見子之為陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"即生男。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取日干旺処，陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支生䖏是也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳内蔵邜酉神，两門出入是其囙。子午乗龍妻妾娠，血支血","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌生氣并","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月将如産母行年，数至今日之辰看。若值空亡兼𠇮年，三合四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞望生難。月将加母行年数至今辰，若空，及年𠇮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"值四杀，三合㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神月建母行年，三䖏同将一法占，隂即為女阳即男，三𠁅二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空胎，盡然三䖏見両重，空亡又加墓地是胎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇白虎若重逢，更帯𣅏传两子同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"飛廉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三传","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大殺虎玄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空，湏更立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"產在其中。蛇虎两重者，假令已作蛇，已在蛇本位，故云两","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531558073679872"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重。又須帯兒子主双生。假如己巳日午将巳時，虎視課两重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"即两重白虎也。後扵申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申時生两男。若三传中逄大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，白虎、元武天空，立產大煞旁。金氏硃注：飛廉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類不逄空旺相乗，传生支合叓湏成。見類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼空刑害，所幹不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遂類中明。幹事三傳上下相生，支神三六合干合，所幹成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占婚二后忌刑傷，子逄天后女贒良。丑为天乙男清秀。占妻占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得喜非常，二后無剋戰刑害。若子作天后女新妍，丑作天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄己酉丑三传，婚婣異類隔山川。五行依此言三合，須知四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格不同，然従革難成，衆中分雜之意也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺氣與日為官鬼，勾朱貴會訟官司相歴不陷于渉害，支干三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合為奇。占鬼传中見旺氣，来剋為官鬼，更雀勾貴者，便","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言事因官府。又神将上下不落空亡，又須不歷渉害与支干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上三合六合，官司必成，對訟伸雪必勝。人老占病必死。如丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：午将寅時，老病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相氣初尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為財，定知財上事闋懐。将遇后隂并上合，便於妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妾位中猜。传中見相氣，与日为財，即主財事。后隂六合，便","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是妻㕝。為今","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫便言子孫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𫝊死占","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為鬼并死兼喪弔墓煞乗蛇虎玄命丧家㕝，披刑帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞任須停。传中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"死尅炁日披刑煞等官，任上占得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必囙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丧人口而歸也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囚動","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼，二獄逢傅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"墓勾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇雀虎叢，官灾牢禁□狱中，化作空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旹反不凶。傳見囚氣，剋日重加，天地二獄，或传入墓，将見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531570035769407"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾雀等凶。天獄，春辰夏午，秋戌冬子，一云夏未冬丑。地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獄正戌逆行。十二辰月獄同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囚氣歲月并飛廉煞上𠀘赦朱雀兼官㕝，終須見赦原。囚与","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和藏避占，傳中囚炁動，𡻷月二馬并大杀，或大煞之上日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雀与天赦㝎赦原，若囚炁与囸和，神将無戰者，其人占□避","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天赦。正未順四季大煞，正戌二巳、三午、四末，五寅、六卯、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七辰、八亥、九子、十丑十一申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二酉即飛廉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休動與囸墓神并，被刑害鬼病來縈。老幼逢休死之靈，如用官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼訟之瞋。传中休氣動，今","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓神披刑害鬼，主占病与日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何類，便是何等人病。生日為父母，即言父母老者之類。小□","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531558073745408"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占得必死，生炁纔生，休乃老者，故曰死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉為格，子午関天罡。如𠁅事多艱，加干子邜多阻𣻉午酉河","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"津道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"罡加子午，為幞𡖉酒力板子丫无天関，午上為地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"関，卯上为天格，酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"为地格。天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"関格必因天時风雨之類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所格；地之関格，必因路險河漲関津所格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"涉害為用，淂火神，下臨壬癸隔江津，土神若見甲占寅，定應阻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隔在山林。渉害為用，淂火神下臨壬癸，水路有阻隔；若用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土神下臨甲寅，以山林来向有阻也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"渉害为用，淂金神下臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午散財，因木神在扵庚辛上，衟路兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戈阻隔人。更以式中刑害空亾官鬼旺相休囚消息言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531570035785791"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天空乘未井為妖，家内興灾非一朝。勾陳辰卯訟相招，血忌来","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨詔不饒。井妖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主家中有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宿病之人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳、末雀及六合，官事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未免迍。如乗戌卯丑传上，問病須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"教泪滿襟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河魁休舊住河魁，尊长遭殃是𬼘媒。若逢天后隂人害，戌日丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加戌上猜。戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加戌，尊长病。戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑加戌同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲臨支上人宅屯，下克之时災更深。支上鬼加，主遷動。如逄白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎病傷人，太岁入宅，又克支凶，加支是鬼，主宅移","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄前一位為羊刄，三傳曰辰忌見臨，非官即病膿血疾加宅作。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎是𢃄血𨻝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531491803758602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合乙卯木爲之，子孫凶吉就中推。若临申酉定悲泣，木絶鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旤逢何疑。申酉作六合，子不利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天后三传與日辰。天后之阴虎害人，占妻病此騐如神。□饒有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"救死为隣男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋妻。假令丙寅日子将願時，戌加寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為用，占妻病，乃半月必死。后陰初虎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑加戌土作白虎，外人丧服入家中。午加卯上子細□，托人失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"信事無功。寅能生火，邜能殺也，火生扵寅，敗扵卯，午加卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用唐壬。二子日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑加河魁更作空，奴僕为人最尀容。加臨支上法一同，未許教","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君取次窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531558073778176"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑加支上虎臨傳，田產交加事可占。切須僧道事干連，式中推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"究意精專","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午加支上作螣蛇，寅日占来回祿嗟。假饒淂免焚其宅，遺禍鄉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隣乱似麻。壬寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午加寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已到天罡㝎主䘮，出門或見哭傍徨。若臨干上作朱雀，㝎知官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"叓當推詳。巳加辰為孝服事，㦯出门塗哭泣叓。乙木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"車已是軫星巳加朱雀，必占灶事。庚辛占見蒿矢巳加。有癸邜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日，辰加卯，巳加辰，午加巳，三传辰巳午。癸酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遥剋，未加申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己加午，午加未，三传未午己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加卯上意何如？木履弓弩推不虚。加申作隂口舌虞，入官争","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531558073761792"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訟必因朱。巳如卯，以木履弓弩推之。若巳加申作太陰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主陰人和合，中有口舌。若作雀便言讼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加申相刑合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥日是辛卯癸未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已加邜遥克","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇入廟刀鉄囙，翻作青離險峻臨。申加巳上用為真，古法分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明騐若神。申加已定占刀鉄事，若作龍疑險㕝。申亥寅六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲六丙，庚寅丁巳夜蛇，壬寅癸巳夜𢅛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斗加日本名天獄，淂是湏知卜訟庭。传見貴人并六害，交加之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事及相縈。乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰加亥，亡木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於亥辰，斗罡也，故知占讼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又見貴人六害主交加。牽連","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午火臨亥死絶鄉，传中丑午害同詳。若还臨在空亾上，㝎知虗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531459591634971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燒不為殃。传中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為六害，入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"空不亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"为殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑由子未寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令今","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是庚辰，太乙為用属比隣。辰日若用起太乙，應在未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已時真","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用傳与日是妻財，類是陰人反卦猜。更見后隂并六合，妻背夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心仔细裁。妻才類，須是陰神及反吟。作如此占","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡逺近。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何占用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内歲尋常，傳神旬裏不虗言，直","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疑應日前。如太𡻕在寅，発用在寅則在年內，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起斗建則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應在月内，用起","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干不出旬，用起支神不生一日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奴是天魁与天空，從魁為婢太隂同，妾求天乙若臨從，分明花","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藥作儀容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531459591651355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸終於艮卦中，事若浮雲豈有踪。甲乙尤怕到離宫，花随流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水去匆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"匆绝神木到午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死。水到艮病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳怕逢曲直鄉。木旺逄侵忌有殃。庚辛炎上不商量，火忌水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神有所妨。鬼三合戊巳土逢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為鬼旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚日辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"炎七不利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁龍合散人财。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"勾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳辰卯主官炎。白虎魁罡巳午来，占人孝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"服㕝堪猜。神将自戰龙合属木，丙丁見之為火出，木木𥁞灰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤇆。勾陳土加邜，不淂地，魁罡加巳午，主孝服","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進策干謁列侯。門","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰年上貴人存，龍合入传喜氣津，蛇虎加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之必避奔。須是貴加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰行年，龙合入傳，主貴人見喜，蛇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎不出見，従見亦不喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531570035802175"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午返吟移妆房，己巳元武灶两廂。天空加巳灶破損，此言應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"騐不尋常。己巳日返吟，夜将得元武，主两𠁅有灶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥日辰加亥用真，退人進口豈𤍍音。天門在亥天関辰，此法從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"来不易深","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體得无淫六害隨，娼家媍女不湏疑。酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"落空亡酉地，寡婦元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來極易詳。如甲戌旬，以申酉為空亡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺鬼占官属禁囚。相妻争貸死傷憂，囚主訟刑休病愁，此法從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"来不易求。春木旺火相，土死金囚水休。如戊巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占淂木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神動，主官事。若傳入三光、三陽等課，不淂一例断之。為官事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸日占得用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起火神准的，𠰥不是妻財，不淂一例断之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531541577547830"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍為玄武乗牛背，加在田神為用辰，來情定是占走失。甲戊庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌日为真，辰加丑見元武，如今","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支干又是无用，若是甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊、庚三戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂此課，定占走失。甲戌戊戌庚戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰加酉上作青龍，剌腿之人必是傭。辰還加亥作玄武，遺失終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須是敗蹤。刺龙於腿上之人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武在亥盗難追，在戌須幽入墓迷。若帯空亡敗可期，帶馬他","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"州㝎捕之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㦯臨羊刃主殘傷，大煞主財落空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亡業死，不过三日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敗，生氣出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月見其賘。元武临羊刃，主傷大杀，主失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物。初主末，賊居中，初剋中，轉賍露踪；末剋其中，因首捕，中来剋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531483062779942"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"末，反𮞸凶，中來尅寸，盗傷捕人害主故也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元乘二馬不辭危，跨屋踰垣捷似飛。地户水窗穿竅入，天门樓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閣逐繩歸。地户，坎宫也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"玄乗地户。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水地道来門，乗天必自。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梯䋲來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武天门二馬馳，長绳之煞𭕐中推，何必踰墻鑒壁回。天窓懸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞入無疑。長䋲杀正酉順四仲，週而復始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用𧺫三交羅䋄同。関隔相併路难通。三者數逢盗易窮，空亡刧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反失前功。天羅夫網卦易敗，空亾便執捕亦逺，透不全","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳一神忌落空，捕人百計不成功，若非怯懦賞不𠑽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盗椉旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣難當鋒，要勾陳有氣，若在空亡，非捕人力不能敵，即賞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錢不𠑽其意不𡧓向前。元武旺又淂地，則难捕。春。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531562989568015"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為武，臨寅邜，旺也，臨申酉，失也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
