{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803883042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一占丁酉日亥将加己","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803899426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉時，三传","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803899426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉亥丑贵隂常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來意，盗賊殺人。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803899426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後獲賊，是一婦人，引奸与一","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803915810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行者殺死一僧一僕，扵舟中沉水内。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803915810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其媍","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803932194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"与。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僧通，猶妻也。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803932194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𢴃經。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803948578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉為少女，是囙妻𧺫叓。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803964962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥爲鬼為賊，为孤獨之人，未敢㝎論，是","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803981346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賊傷人。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803981346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由初建观之，先尋今日建鬼是癸𫝁乗天空，是行人，亦","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803997730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是舟人。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820803997730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥辛為今日妻，亥邜相合，是妻与行人謝殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804014114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以復","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804030498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建觀之，酉得癸臨丁，酉為妻，癸為鬼，是妻来害己也。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804030498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此婦是癸","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804046882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉生，亦可怪，雖繫狱，遭世变而漏網","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804046882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一占。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804063266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804079650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年庚寅","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804079650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804079650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"将加甲申时，三傳","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804079650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰午、申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"来","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804079650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合青虎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"意，失盗鈔三百張。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804079650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𢴃經失鋒門是","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804096034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531654278512659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"内","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鈔，又是馬，值事門是白虎，為驚憂，中傳鬼作龙，財物□然。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804096034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804112418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為旬空，未敢以盗賊言。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804112418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖元武乗戌，是庚之印，亦未言賊也。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804128802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804145186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初建言之，為丙戌，丙為庚之鬼，以復䢖言之，得甲戌，是復建生","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804145186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初建，鬼太旺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804145186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况乗元武，是盗失。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804161570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以戌為僕，太陽在戌，又是","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804177954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴都，日為白，曰賊也。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804177954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌与寅三合，是同類之人，否則屋主之親，","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804194338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自西南而来，藏扵南方而居扵西北，相去甚近。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804194338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌至戌相隔一","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804210722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804210722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄戌申纯氜為男，臨孟為少。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804227106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申至戌二位，主二人後獲一","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804243490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"半。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804243490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以下终是伭来生干，中末空，盜者利纏。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804259874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經以辰上是者，為所","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804276258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失之物。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804276258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今寅上見辰，辰乃月建，建建為贵物，此鈔乃世之所貴","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804292642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，祭用助日，我為有氣矣","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804292642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804309026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由是觀之，生中有鬼，財中有尅，皆在","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804325410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531735845044264"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建干变化也。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804325410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此凝神子郭璞所以妙出人表也","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804341794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804358178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若取来性，当以","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804374562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聚散鬼救論。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804374562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若断休咎，只用干為主，三傳","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804390946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅正時論，不必用","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804390946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"变求竒也。","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804390946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人云：求竒反不奇","logicSentenceId":"7679099820804407330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
