{"lines":[{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雨水前","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702481920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯初刻，太陽入衛用登明亥春分後後巳一刻，入魯河魁作","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702481920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"将明。","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702481920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榖雨後四亥初刻，入趙従魁用可稱","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702498304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉，小滿，後□酉三。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刻入晉还语传送□。","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702498304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至後四未一刻，入秦，小吉用其名。","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702514688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"末大暑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後三巳一刻，入周，先用勝光灵。","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702531072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䖏暑後","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702547456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳二刻，入梦，还当太乙𨒖巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702547456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋分後七寅三刻，入郑，天罡用","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702563840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亨。","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702563840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霜降後九丑三刻，太冲運動宋州城。","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702580224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小雪後七戌一刻，功曺将领入燕。","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702596608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅，京。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至後四亥一刻，入吳，大吉便休停。","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702612992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大寒當曰酉三刻，入斉神后𡻕功成。","logicSentenceId":"7679100057702629376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531777813397558"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"管輅神書","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卷十五論終身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支傳課作提綱，先審安身無所傷。事業一生經歷處，存亾𨼆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見莫胡詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬课以十為主，干者，我也，其干支课傳上神，皆我之用𪠥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以首課入傳爲终身經歷者，有以支起入传為终身經歷者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有以干之隂神起博為終身經歷者，有以支之隂神起传為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終身經歷者；有以初傳末傳作鬼歸干支為终身經歷者。皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以生干比干為上吉。若干尅干上神，支課用上神為次吉，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安身無所傷也，此為上吉之数。若干支上神用傳上神，㦯刻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"管輅神書卷十五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531705805570082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害刑冲破干，是我身無所宴著，以至絶嗣敗家灾訟丧命，終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□會，成下等之數也，務宜詳之。若占功名，則八剋我者為官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又從貴論，不在此限也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干禄淂地可荣身，畧𪠥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690881707819044/1-3ac84c96414371aa.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=jhIzW4wd%2FbF3kS9cWu2bSrt5hjs%3D","uri":"read/HY0785/2/ref/1kp44yll2xbtx/1-3ac84c96414371aa.webp","fontType":1,"components":"此⺀","variants":"些","charPicId":"7456690881707819044"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷支用尋。尋到好地方住脚，有些疑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惑不堪停。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承上言，既審十無所傷，尤宜㸔于上之禄神淂地，則求名有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，□享庻人有禄，百用九流，百工技藝，生意子資要不空限并年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命，干支传用又不來刑冲剋破此禄，斯謂禄名所傷，終身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/HY1664/7442287473817813029/1-1739271304990.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=3hP58pN97cLRSxn%2FtmUZRGOT6ms%3D","uri":"read/HY1664/4/ref/1kr8eoyhqtoo2/1-1739271304990.webp","fontType":3,"components":"","variants":"可","charPicId":"7470112515755311123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"守富貴，乃美数也。若禄被刑冲破陷，是禄有傷，既無所靠，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尋支上神之禄，㦯弄祿，則尋用傳上之禄神名空陷刑冲破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531743256592394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋害為吉。盖千禄乃自身营為之禄，支禄家中現成之禄，用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傳之禄，徃耒营求之祿也。三者得一為美數。如三者俱無，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有禄不吉，則無所立脚，不可停守矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或財或比或生身，今傷無剋细推尋。得候𥡷中堪下脚，莫令衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敗又名存。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如課传無禄可依，当尋我之財，或比或生，俱要名刑冲尅破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害，方為平穩，可立脚矣。□有所傷而又入衰敗之鄉，則名靠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失審干□作元囙，次把用傳配合尋。初不成𫝊方看二，方知此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事□何目原本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"作若不成俧方看救，要知救我有何神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531771677147145"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"課無全吉，宐生尋干上以究其原目，次看用传以審其運用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如初传空尅有傷，則㸔中传、末𫝊有何救我之神，何方可靠，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何人可依，何事可為，雖不能成大富貴，六𠂝為终身之依，數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中無依，斯為下也。然壬課有吉有凶，不可執一而論。如占功","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名，明無官星，㦯有官星而受空剋，則又以暗遁□官星父毋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得地無傷，所臨吉神吉煞，六𠂝販貴。如遁再凶，則功名不成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。如常人吕眀名财星，或有財星空尅，又以暗遁得財星父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母得地無傷，𫠦臨有吉神吉煞，不可取財。若遁干又無所取，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則射不聚矣。又有明吉而遁凶，𡖋為有害，務宜詳之。又察年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命上神与日干并用，上神或生或比，㦯刑剋冲破害，方為得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531771677130761"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"却有空。己臨吉神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690870036381707/1-4f74202a374c7323.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0w6DmU9%2BnVucnsuT92erx4zgB1o%3D","uri":"read/NA02768/7/ref/1kzvi6b4be5u1/1-4f74202a374c7323.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丶⺀","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690870036381707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690870036381707/1-4f74202a374c7323.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0w6DmU9%2BnVucnsuT92erx4zgB1o%3D","uri":"read/NA02768/7/ref/1kzvi6b4be5u1/1-4f74202a374c7323.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丶⺀","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690870036381707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名倚不和平。惟有凶神臨日辰，就言其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事主吳迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰空亾為真。空亡作事無力。在地曰孤，無妻可依；在天曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寡，每夫𠂝依。凢㐫神刑冲破㝢宐空。若生我救我者，不宜空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如初傳空，末传實，攴雖無着，後𨚫有成。如中传空，事将成而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中止。如末𫝊空，事终無结果。如上暴病、憂賊争訟，空則吉，久","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病占，如空，必主死。餘□吉，主人財徒失。惟金水不嫌空，有生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不為空。月将太歲、月建、日時、年命填实為不空，不可全以空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531712164052992"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論。如吕坟宅取支，左空則空左，右空則空右，先言而后空不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嫌。如占六畜逄空，㸔其地分。若探加不淂位，必有損傷。探加。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得地臨生氣，雖空不妨。如吕子孫帶空蹤，有子是空中来，㦯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸生，或過继，不然主有傷。如占才名，生宴後空，主後有阻鬲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不遂意，破財。如占買賣，帶空不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬中空亡，當以類推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子旬中密戍亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子、乙丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空才，父既入空，雖吉不可。用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊辰，己巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空兄才","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午，空。辛未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬申，癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官兄𭂫占有十𢙣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大敗，日名無禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲辰、壬申、丁亥、戊以辛巳日。乙巳、丙申、庚辰、癸亥、己丑，此十日内無禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才空亡，故曰大敗。占身無才祿，决然不安。占夀無才禄，六是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531712164036608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不美，但采傳中有生六不死，直符克年方死。占官求才，俱為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用空入生，廢事再末，遇隂而昩，還是沈埋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天空入空旺相所合中雖是阻，婚姻必吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用空居長生之地，是事不成而再發。传入太隂在工，事雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靈機，而又入暗昧之地，将成又廢，畢竟是空，不可以值長生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而謂事得再成也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用空入干，舊事再發。凶則宜避，吉則莫舍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用作空亡，而末傳歸扵日上，主舊事再彂。若帶吉神良将，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當為之而不可捨；若带㐫神𢙣将，則宐逃之而不可為。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空扵其妻，⺀⺀復歸，初","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690874182205476/1-83b99841f3001c2c.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=zYVUHUCrNmXY7P9ESaBjClJ4kH0%3D","uri":"read/HY1779/8/ref/1kyv3vte01pmx/1-83b99841f3001c2c.webp","fontType":1,"components":"毛隹","variants":"㲝","charPicId":"7456690874182205476"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有傷浚，当再為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天空入空，又休又刑，婚姻虗喜，终見名成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531743256608778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支為宅，為妻入空，是空扵其妻也。若财亦然，生見其空，而后","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有妻才入寔，未娶者先難后成也；既娶者，先奸後娶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若失空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而未得子孫生之，亦主再娶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用見其妻，復入扵空，半路㫁絃，何日續终。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發用見其妻才，㦯中末入空，主断絃難續。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻雖入空，旺氣所鍾，一則有喜，一則病冲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初传入空，而中末歸旺，是空中有病，旺中有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是病中句，□氏㫄註一喜一憂口字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空扵其子，復見其子，子雖初乗，后還有濟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子發用入空，是初年難為子也。中、末二传而子星入实，是為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531712164069376"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後終有子。如末得父母生之，亦為有子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用見其子，復入扵空，子雖相逄，不是其終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用見子本有子，傳入空亾死绝之鄉，中年必䘮成家之子，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然，有殘疾破家，或離鄕背井，不能送父曲之終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴入扵空，干貴反兇，當謂莫謁，当逄莫逄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人，能觧祸生福，若入空則不得力也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴入于空，求名虛殸。传入二死，不善其身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中末入二死，是慕功名，终身無成也。中末逄生助後猶有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"望也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地入扵空，可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"免諸凶，任尓出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入自迪其功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凶将入空，诸凶可免，而虫入有功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱入扵空，望文不就；執不如捨，進則难售。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531654278660115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雀為文书入空，雖旺不就，不如别謀是非，口舌則免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合入空，求財難通，不宜賣買，互見相攻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合為才，婚姻和合之神，空則彼此不合而相攻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾入扵空，官無訟凶。在外莫見，在後莫容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾乃争門之神，入空訟無外見，有勾引，末传見有後祸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又□氏註。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰一云：曰前為外，曰後為内。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍入非空，仍作我妻，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690870036381707/1-4f74202a374c7323.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0w6DmU9%2BnVucnsuT92erx4zgB1o%3D","uri":"read/NA02768/7/ref/1kzvi6b4be5u1/1-4f74202a374c7323.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丶⺀","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690870036381707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丶見傷，難再言歸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍乃賢德之神，入空則傷。妻者，干支上神合也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍入于空，仍作我財，一半可得，一半可諧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍乃財喜之神，空則財可半得，不能全獲矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531771677163529"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龙入扵窍，仍作我官，志雖慕貴，不得成懽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天空入空，諸事无踪。吉不作吉，凶不作凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡劫殺凶神，加天空入空，俱有影無刑，凶吉不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎入空，见㐫不凶，宐扵出徃，反得其功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎凶空，更末傳吉将，反得其功，可任意出外。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常入於空，丧吊又逄。為親為服，何事匆匆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太常孝服，神帶丧吊，主親服，百事不遂，安得匆匆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎喜入空，有兔在上，即日离身，子母無恙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常入於空，作官不蒙。雖有天馬，亦莫騰通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常又為印绶，空則不沐朝賜，安能飛騰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531705805602850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常入扵空，求財不成。当安不安，当行不行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常又為財神，空則財不能鱿，若傳課無依，当守窮而不可𡚶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動妄為。为","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎喜入空無鬼，不旺之子云亡𫠉之得当。此條六必金氏增入。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄入於空，谋害不凶，疑其盗失，无入吾宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"武為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謀害神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂后入空，女詐不逢，反得隂秘，而有后通。太明天后，女詐之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論空亡作鬼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡作鬼，帯負謾。隂空相乗，事欺慢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空鬼𢃄負謾，乗天空太阴，主有欺滿骗害之事。謾語。正午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順十二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531777813430326"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡作鬼，𢃄五盗，主耗相乗，有失耗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空鬼乗玄武，五盗二耗，其賊必自空中而来，財是空中而去，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失耗之事，不免五盗。正丑逆十二大耗；正戌逆，十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小耗；正邜逆，十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凢神煞之不見於六壬經緯者，硃標此出之條。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"时崖。硃批：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡作鬼帶馬丁，有人迯出，事忙忙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"密。鬼𢃄丁馬，必有人逃出，不然則主𩀌郷遇慫之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支是天空，行人信通，帶喜尤妙，不宐入親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天空乃文書专報，神加支上，有外信，入家入空不以信論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡克日𨚫無依，孤单冷淡過生时。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"發用笁鬼切主人，無依单冷遇一生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴雀作兎，入扵空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亡文字，貴物乃是其。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531743629656074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用乗贵雀空鬼，文書贵物，乃當自慎。餘以神煞詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滕虵作鬼，入扵空亾，驚惶走失，又作火光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用雖入空，不免驚惶走失火光之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀作鬼，入於空亡，不无虗誕，信息為狂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合作鬼，入扵空亡，文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/HY2437/7442288266474160154/1-1738377204469.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=vXWidFu4c1bkVWqKP%2F8KpBS5y2w%3D","uri":"read/NA02935/2/ref/1kuwsliy89kiv/1-1738377204469.webp","fontType":3,"components":"","variants":"關","charPicId":"7466235748129538083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為美，亦宜自防。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"交侯喜美中，亦宐慎之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陣作鬼，入於空亡，肉勾外連，尤防其殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍作鬼，入于空七，喜中見賊，亦宐自防。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天空作鬼，入于空切，尤防暗損，诸事微芒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白馬作鬼，入扵空亡，殺傷門訟，又作驚惶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太常作鬼，入扵空切，錢糓恆印，并失衣裳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤣥武作鬼，入於空亡，赱失盗賊，亦当豫防。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531811178889242"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂作兔，入扵空，陰謀相妬，婢妾死亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天后作鬼，入於空亡，衣裳首飾，走失須防。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論破神：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破神最是不相宜，入乾却有内人欺，若是臨支被外侮，一切交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逰捴不如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破神陽日後三辰，如子日見酉，寅日見亥；隂日前三辰，如丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日是辰，邜日見午。二破若在曰干上主家内隣人欺，支上主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外人朋友侮。干支互相破，則外破内，内破外，文相破害。大抵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄破，凡事不成。才見破財失物，見破物凶，是破不成凶。貴人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見破，則功名荐引，干貴不成；騰蛇見破，則牵連提帯，作事不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531811178905626"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"允。朱雀見破，則文書口舌，暗於不徐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合則破，則賣買交関，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婚姻纳子不就；勾陳則争鬥田産，坟墓，矢闲不就。青龍見破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則求財婚姻，公文，案卷不舉；天空見破，則文書進纳，奴婢不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就，文學舉業不成。元武破則隂谋賊党不魷，投師立學不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太氤破則隂謀金錢，関節不通；天后則恩澤詔赦不来，婚姻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不就。太常破則薦本推官，婚姻酒食中止。白馬破則道𨅌防","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劫，武舉不成。金氏旁注曰：即月破是也。又隔四位相加。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破者，如評論神煞，必有損破不能饒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"破即四破，騐神煞，以審所破之由。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡻕破加扵月破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中吉将相逢也不。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"容更有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"与。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，将破財壊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事主貧家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531724117737508"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲月破入課為用，一破難当。又兼二破為用，則吉事不成，㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所不免。更有凶神凶将，財破事壊，貧家到底無成立也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲者，如何論神煞，必有横禍，審所捛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲。即破碎煞，子午邜酉在巳，寅申己亥在酉，辰戊丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未在丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再詳神煞，以審所招。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㦯破㦯廢，传上居事，皆破廢不𣲠疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破者，年月日時四破，廢者，四廢。若用帶破廢煞，凢事不遂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"碎在三传，事不成，中則狐疑，末無後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破碎煞才遇陂才，事遇破事，物遇破物，初傳得之，即不成中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"传得之，孤疑不决，末传得之，终無帰着。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531731466174527"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥相中有貴空，迷神関隔又相逢，要行不行語不通，為事蕭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"條竟没踪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥相加，上乗貴人，天空，己亥自相冲，再加迷神闲隔，要行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不行，要語不語，凢事赼趄也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人慱□绝见刑破，又臨衰敗，主每親","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或破㦯廢俱入𫝊，不是破残帯疾吁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用传帯破廢，凡事不成謀不遂。若帯病符天鬼，主殘疾之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破侮須知忍在心，謾将狂語出傷人。但宐速闭母令後，好計方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以勝且嬴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用見四破，又見刑害、闭口、朱雀、謾语等神，破為神人侮，勿即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531735845191720"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以言傷人，宜當闭口含忍，以計勝之，則破者豈能壊我。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月破加扵辰伐宮，其年必有跌傷凶。若加死氣患朦朧，生炁加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之喜氣濃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戍乃跌卧殺發用，月破加其上，主跌蹼灾；加死汽主䑃朧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之難；加生爲雖危無事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡻕破月上加玄空，必有逃走人不容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日上乘玄武、天空，又加崴破，必有逸走出外之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卷十六論刑冲害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑者，傷殺之象，即三刑也。主上下不相合，□柔不相濟，燥𭧂自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害爽刄。凢入課者，為吉為凶，吉多则輔士為吉，凶多則輔凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531771677196297"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥相中有貴空，迷神関隔又相逢，要行不行，語不通，儉事蕭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"條竟没踪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥相加，上乘貴人天空，己亥自相冲，再加迷神闲隔，要行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不行，要語不語，凢事赼趄也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人慱□绝，见刑破，又臨衰敗，主每親","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或破㦯廢，俱入𫝊，不是破残帯疾吁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用传帯破廢，凡事不成，謀不遂。若帯病符天鬼，主殘疾之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破侮須知忍在心，謾将狂語出傷人，但宐速闭母，令後好計，方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以勝且嬴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用見四破，又見刑害、闭口、朱雀、謾语等神，破為神人侮，勿即。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531705805635618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以言傷人，宜當闭口含忍，以計勝之，則破者豈能壊我？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月破加扵辰戍宮，其年必有跌傷凶，若加死氣患朦朧，生𪸓加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之喜氣濃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戍乃跌卧殺發用，月破加其上，主跌璞灾；加死炁，主䑃朧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之難；加生爲，雖危無事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡻕破月上加玄空，必有逃走人不容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日上乘玄武、天空，又加嵗破，必有逸走出外之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卷十六論刑冲害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑者，傷殺之象，即三刑也。主上下不相合，□柔不相濟，燥𭧂自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害爽刄凢入課者，為吉為凶，吉多则輔士為吉，凶多則輔凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531724117786660"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為凶。旺相如乗車葘馬，休囚如被禁加笞，主口舌凶惡，憂擾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失吁，不宐占病干谒賔主。在常人则取罪戾，惟宜捕捉，君子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得之，則為威權。其名有四：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰自刑。辰午□玄，自相刑害，落敗則别改更，自𭓸自大，自作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自受，自逞其能，自受其禍，死扵非命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二𠮚無礼，刑子刑卯，卯刑子是陽精，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日陽氣在子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而郎為日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門，子為邜之𤰞位，而無卑𢙄。子為貪狼，邜為隂賊，死敗相刑，門","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"户不利，大小淫亂。如夘加子，明入暗出，水陸不通，子息不律。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三曰無恩之刑，寅刑己，巳刑申，申刑寅，寅中有襍火，巳中有襍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尔，申中有襍水，故寅刑巳，刑中有害，舉動艱難；彼刑我闻，官事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531735845224488"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾殃。巳刑申，刑中有合，長幻不順㞿犯。後合波刑我解，𡨚讐相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"報。申刑寅，刑中冲破，人鬼侵凌，男女相係；彼刑我動，殘賊相施。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四回恃執之刑，上位在戌，寄旺四季，正旺在未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未恃旺而刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之冠帶，丑恃冠帯而刑戍，戍恃天刑而刑未之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺。又曰：丑刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，戌遷其怒，自恃旬首而刑未。丑刑戌，刑中有暗鬼，乃貴刑賤，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大刑小，刑禁官事。戍刑末，刑中有破，𤰞少凌長，妻財不豊舉動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不科未刑丑，刑中亦破，大小不和，兄弟不顺，㦯有丧服發用逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，多生災害。刑千傷男，刑辰傷女，旺刑衰則福生，死刑旺則旤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𧺫。時刑干則憂小人；用刑旹則行不利；善刑惡則每憂，惡刑善","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則㐫至。刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可訟。人刑日辰，不可逺行；刑支干則人宅不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531705805668386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安。十刑者速，支刑者缓。若上下相刑，又見日鬼，則氣象垂戾反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覆，公私之憂，不少緩矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制𠨙之刑，十干聚克，逆乱乃生，故加刑以制𠨙之。凡干支所加，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戰鬥不出其下。甲刑申，乙刑酉，丙刑子，丁刑亥，戊刑寅，己刑卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚刑午，辛刑巳，生刑戌，癸刑未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲者，擊動之煞，初雖有得，后必傾覆，主搖動，反復不寧。在日身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有𨓹，在辰宅有動。乗凶将損動，乗元武逃動，乗后隂暗動，乗元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，盗失淫佚，出入更改。乗勾陳，私邪，争競改豪。子午冲，道𨅌馳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"躯，男女交争，謀動□遷。邜壬相加，门戶分異，失脫更改。寅申冲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人兔刑傷，男女異心。己亥冲，事多反覆，重求輕得。丑未冲，兄弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531731466207295"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"異心，谋事不遂。辰戍冲，悲喜雜異，贵賤不明，奴僕逃走，𬮦節不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行。大抵吉不宜冲，凶则散。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害者，侵損凌害之象。隂陽不順如水，壅滯，如血未行，事多阻抑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子加未，吏巫终始，官灾口舌。未加子，營謀阻滯，虫入有灾。丑加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午，病訟多凶，夫婦不睦。午加丑，為卑小凌把長上，事多不明，難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得成𭕐。寅加巳，為争進相害，出入改動，退利進阻。巳加寅，作事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艱難。卯加辰，為事下凌上之害，有虗声，爭才阻隔。辰加卯，心绪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不寕。申加亥，為疾詭之害，先阻後得，必無终始。亥加申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圖谋未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遂，事無本末，酉加以暗昧凶。凡占口舌官非，守囘少㤙，害者，妨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。在刑煞之间","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531777813479478"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論丁神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神者，乃變動之神也。凡占惟庚辛日為凶動，壬癸日為財動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午辛未日見卯，囙妻而凶動，因才而旤起。庚辰、辛巳曰見丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因墓田而凶動，旺相為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"田死囚為墓，辰寅辛卯日是亥，因子壻庚為兄辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而凶動。庚子辛丑日見酉，因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄弟而凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"并及己身，為弟及己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戍辛亥日見未，因父母長上灾而凶動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申辛壬曰見巳，因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼而凶動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬壬者，乃歸藏之所，与六丁相加，豈無所為？生申癸壬日見卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因子息之木而凶動；壬午癸未日見丑，囙官鬼之才而凶動；壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰癸巳日見亥，因己身及兄弟之才而凶動。壬寅癸邜日，身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890708189247/1-63ddafbe39d7414b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=EpmzGfBUj%2Feuu5B07dCZw%2B2iuOE%3D","uri":"read/HY1366/16/ref/1kpj1n5og59o4/1-63ddafbe39d7414b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"一〢目","variants":"酉","charPicId":"7456690890708189247"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531811178938394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因父毋長上之才而凶動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子癸丑日見未，因官司之財而凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動；壬戍癸亥日見巳，因妻妾之才而凶動。如癸丑日，干上末作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初傳，不取其才，縁三传火鬼，如蜜中砒也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡丁神外已得之，萬裏逺遁；盗賊得之，隱匿難獲；婚姻得之，聚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散成奸；病訟得之，迷㝠難伸；為官得之，巡行杳覈。𢃄蛇馬，主逃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亾逺行；帶序，主憂思；𢃄陰后，主女走；𢃄天空，奴婢走；帯元武，盗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賊走失；帯雀，吾信動；帯勾，主兵馬逺来；带𮸲主飛腾；帯六合逺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行；𢃄三陰，魄化丧魂，主病，有可生。帶三光、三陽、六儀、三竒、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍德，主官升財遂。𢃄天網、天獄、九醜，主宫府変動，有抑可伸，合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中有変，新故有更；帯孤神，绝嗣無禄，内中有復續之图。帶乱首、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531724117803044"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"贅壻，部戰生剋，有非常之变。闭口可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690879902892073/1-0c943513a5687e25.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=OjW1eI9nUNuUWiuLgnamHIKf1fA%3D","uri":"read/HY2169/2/ref/1kpj90o9bwefj/1-0c943513a5687e25.webp","fontType":1,"components":"门井","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690879902892073"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斬，𨴊可斷。三交𣣔移，逰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子不返；八專佚女，久而生禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元首則吉㐫，在長上者必動重審。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則六凶在务，少者少咸，皆有反戾之心，涉害有生旤之執。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"返吟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動扵逺思，伏吟起其歸興，鬼附蛇朱，却耒生怪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"静者欲動，動者不停，闲事欲𧺫，罷叟再生，遊子不返。帶吉則声","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動應，帯凶則凶動应。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛日伏吟有馬丁，行人即日是歸程。桑日馬丁雖出現，行人未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠊳轉回程。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏吟課凡事遲滯，行人不來。㓡曰帯馬丁逰煞，則可以望其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"来，棄日蹔出，可以至家，逺行未到也。逰煞正邜順十二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531743629688842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㓡日伏吟，名自任，可委托於他人。柔日伏哈，名自信，可取决扵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干之神固己主□，若𫝊千支上，亦自内之丁，或乗天馹二馬，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"静而求動。如壬辰、戊午、丙辰、甲寅、甲申，此五日伏吟，有旬丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在傳内者。又癸末、巳壬、辛亥、癸丑，連前共九日，占訪人必出，先","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"允後改，各無任信也。天馬逐月而論，刲内無二馬旬口者，謀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事伏而不𧺫。若有丁馬而占人年命乗魁罡者，主動尤速。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天馬随貴人入庙，如庚子日□月、八月占，天馬随白馬入廟，反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主不動，為访人亦在外方相遇。天馬正月起午，順行六氤位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神靈靈，入于宅神，门移戶改，欲𡨴不𡨴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531724117852196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神旺相加宅，主宅不寧，门户改移之象。若年命傳課中有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生支之神，宅主脩改百居。若無生支之神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又帯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑剋破害空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耗，則宅已变改而不可居也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神灵灵，死主死人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帯月猒，為鬼損才畜。带三合喜神有喜；帯劫煞、飛產飛祸羊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有謀害。在邜辰巳午未申，祸生於日，日宜防之；在酉戌亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑寅，祸生扵夜，夜宜防之。有救神可免其祸；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無救神，利扵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若遙滿曰月之斆衆可出丁神臨與合千有貴人提𢃄，或招飯出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外立事，其𢃄吉神，有皇書等吉，主功名事。飛𤎉正申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順十二飛祸，春申夏寅，秋巳冬亥，入月猒正成逆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531777813495862"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神靈靈而為我財，帯煞冲破，妻死離哀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神為妻財，帯劫煞、女煞、隂煞来冲其妻財，或带己酉丑従","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"草隔角煞，主妻生離，帶二死；妻居墓绝，主死别，𢃄二耗，月破二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"碎之煞，則為冲財，則難守業也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁神灵灵，作鬼剋身。災歌不已，禳祭堪生。丁神王相，作鬼乗亥子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑寅位與月鬼火神生牙刻干者，灾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祸不已。五見天巫咒咀儀神，必湏祭禱神佛，方曰安泰。火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神□丑夏子，秋戌冬亥，生炁正子順十二天匪，正辰顺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二天呪。正子顺四仲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神㑹㑹，賊侵户域。干乗生旺，未免流血。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531731466223679"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神乗元武，盜神劫殺，侵我之域。若千被傷，帶刑冲冲血，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我被傷流血。若支帶刑冲二血，是家㓜小被傷流血也。盗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神春巳夏邜，秋酉冬子，劫殺寅午戌亥、亥邜未神，申子辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳酉丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神靈靈勅𠔥行，一差末了，二差又行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神旺相而芊皇書天詔在歲上作丁者，乃天子之差也。𢃄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皇詔在日辰月建你口者，乃台部之差使，主迭任差使。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書□寅，夏巳，秋申冬亥，天詔正亥順。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神灵灵，皇诏臨辰，使者皇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690866226085951/1-6d9ccd24f5b78034.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=OCvSRUCH4AbjgiFE%2Bk12NHNf0iM%3D","uri":"read/NA05321/8/ref/1kqmppu4c24o7/1-6d9ccd24f5b78034.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𠀃ユ心","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690866226085951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赴我家𨓍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神旺相，作赍人加支而帯皇恩天詔，必有封贈超升之喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531735845257256"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而入我家庭矣。皇恩正戌二丑三辰四未，五壬六□，七子八午九亥十寅、申十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一巳十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神灵灵，㐫煞刑辰，家门頽敗，過房慫人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神旺相，乗凶煞以刑支神，又帯被耗，主家敗。若三交游煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤寡，或加子星工，必主過慫。孤神春巳夏申，秋亥冬寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寡宿春丑夏辰，秋末冬戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神灵德合加申，早晚有慶，福凑寿人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神帶天德、月合德禄來生日千者，主福壽安寧。天德正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁二坤三壬四辛，五轧，六甲七癸，八艮，九丙十乙，十一、巽十。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二庚本月合正辛、二巳三丁，日乙、五辛、六己、七丁、八乙、九辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531724117884964"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十己十一丁，十二乙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神灵，果帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼不寧之子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生祸，如不得停。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神旺相，乘子莅剋支，𢃄劫殺破耗，是子敗家生歌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神靈，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大祸刑千，當躱莫躱，当安莫安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺丁𢃄大祸，刧煞飛庿、尼神二死刑剋其千，是大難数也。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神主動，必有虫入路途之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如傅見建𢅛劫殺、風西雷煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必有風爾之難，所当躲也。传是之武，帶三盗、二都逰，遇劫賊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七事当避。传見白偉，又帯斥煞，乗蛇𢃄蛇煞有序，蛇難当躲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傳見陰后，帶奸明咸池女祸，主女人奸淫事，不能安也。傳為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇，帶病符、月猒，主瘟疫不安。传勾朱𢃄官符、吏神，漢隔天地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531812613357608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盤结，有牢獄不安。随其無化，而因事詳審之可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"関隔魁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"罡加四仲亾神，即旬中辛也。風煞正申逆，十二兩煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正子順四仲。雷煞正己顺，十二二。天盗正寅逆，四孟又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盗，正丑逆，四李。盗神春巳夏夘，秋酉冬子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"重出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逰都、虜都","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己丑未，乙庚子午，丙辛寅申，丁壬己亥戍，癸申寅。姧门","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正寅二申，三巳四亥五寅，周而復始。女祸正亥二巳三申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四寅五亥，周而復始。咸池寅午戌、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯申子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰酉、己酉丑午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐪夘未子。天鬼正酉逆，四仲。官符正午順，十二。吏神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正七亥，二八丑三九卯日十巳五十一未，六十二壬。大祸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正戌逆，十二病符子年亥，丑年子逆輪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531724117868580"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神灵灵，不宜煞刑，当殺莫殺，当侵莫侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神臨羊刄，主殺伐，帶三刑大煞玺神。㦯曰：干得時生旺，可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以殺人，可以侵戰。传入空墓，并𬮦陽休囚，則殺人侵人，自取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其旤。大煞正成逆行，四乘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"哭神，不宐入命季死炁，家中死亡纏，休病本身須有病，犯之末","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂太平天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年命上帶哭神死牙，主死亾；休囚𢃄病符，主病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"哭神春未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏戌，秋丑冬辰，死炁正午顺，十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浴盆邱墓加日辰，死巳刑害加命年。湏知我自不安然，不久應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知入九泉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531712164118528"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰年命乃都门也，日辰上神𢃄浴盆、丘墓，年命上神帯刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害，二死千支，年命入死墓之地，定主死亡也。浴盉類辰夏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未、秋戌、冬丑，三丘□亥夏子、秋寅冬酉，五墓与哭神同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喪弔全逢入課年。素衣日日桂身穿，不丧棲護并骨月，哭泣之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殾動徹天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
