","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690887197622335/1-72437b7f6968a00d.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=R2d62OGfh6tiNz40q278vAKhjtY%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0628/2/ref/1lg47xvgju0ao/1-72437b7f6968a00d.webp","fontType":1,"components":"艹闭","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690887197622335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得人来捉住，他也得平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安。云每事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531712164216832"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用鬼剋干，是與我為仇，前後遇空，是不得進退。外亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命上神有救，可以制鬼，則我無事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有鬼附鬼不為凶。任他丁馬與迷蒙，三三五五自相窮，搃是人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"強鬼不凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干旺相得峕，帶德禄神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天喜支傳上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼雖多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不敢動，任","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其丁馬迷神，三三五五反為射，身强鬼不侵也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陷入其功不可前，馬居鳴俊自蕭然。子宜速轉毋輕𨓏，庶使吾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功得保。金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干被上神剋用，乗太隂、天空，為自隐竒功也，而不前矣。二馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居干之后，在传中，謂之背馬，而馬必不可進，只宜速轉，毋徃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531724117966884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"保功，庶不终敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當傳莫縳，縳則有凶；當打莫打，打則有𥚽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用传帶绳索殺，是縳人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"象作鬼克干当。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縳莫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"縳可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。用传","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶羊刄、勾陳，為打人之象，作鬼剋干，当打莫打可也。必欲縳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人，打人必殁㐫祸。繩煞正酉逆四仲；索煞正卯逆四仲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合浦旺珠何日逢，一木三𱖚二火鎔。推事才乆復沉濛，畢竟三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囬□次中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明珠難逢課传中一木三金二火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金固為日之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才，二火又為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日之比，木既生我而亦生他，兄弟争財，而金不得專矣。再加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劫殺凶神，至争訟不寧，而叓情多滯，不三面□次，安淂顺乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531812613521448"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"適遇子木又入水刼，有隂私刼人起，得才又得刼人錢，一路迢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迨，主有喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木加子，又木得子水相生，亦為木之沐浴。地乘太陰天后為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日之才，又為生氣喜炁，是与劫人有隂私之情。既得其劫，因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸而得才又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得其利，一路迨迨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家有祸起，惟父不喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支子無良，令人生傳死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千父支子，以干克支，是父怒子。千為人，支為宅，支帶咸池劫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺、盗神，是家有祸起，乃子之不良，而父欲克之，則子之旤不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可追。若支上見生，則其罪猶可；支上見死炁，罪不容誅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人有私事，不可以言，子露其風，死𮞸子殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531811178971162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干父支子，干神𢃄劫殺，乗太隂闭口，是父有阴私事，謀人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行，不可与人言。支神反剋干神，或与𫝊用以剋干神，帯朱雀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁神謾語，是子露風於人，而□父之死於非命，豈為孝子？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先庚三日後庚三，此日云為進退恂，務宜准此自盤桓。馬住馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行，不胱鞍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徒庚三日丁也，丁主变動；後庚三日辛也，辛主外隠之神，丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主動，卒主退，是不逢進而盤桓矣。天馬者，月之馬也；馹馬者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日之馬也。一馬出行，有前徃之劳；一馬落空，有欲止之机。是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一行一住而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"脱鞍遇此，欲以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又止，欲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"成又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敗安得遂意？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁乃旬中之丁，辛乃旬中之辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531819672436776"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬不行，諸事宜停。子無前徃，諸事不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬主動，㦯落空，則為不能行，诸事不成，豈能往乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上有鬼𠔃不可上，下有鬼号不百。下中𠋣一个水木地，上下鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"来终是罷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木神作因，上見太陰，是上有鬼，不可上也；下乗申壬，昷下有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼，不可下也。上下逼迫，将何以望？㦯見木比，㦯見水生，是有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"救神，上下之鬼罷矣。餘倣比。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一鬼有性，一鬼無情，相逢何日解我疑謀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"课見二鬼，一鬼落空，一鬼克干，一鬼欲害我，一鬼不害我，㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉不成，而我之疑谋亦不得解矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531724117983268"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一鬼二鬼并三，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼只要有箇好兒子不分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前後事如何，他日家","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財還興起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"課傳官鬼雖多，有子旺相，為吉可救，事敗復立，豈鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"多而忌㢤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂空。辰戌用鬼害刑，被人贈胱，謾語無因。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌乗空，阴為用，作鬼刻干，若帯謾语，主無中生有之事，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空脱我之財也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論争訟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"两數相逢是有争。馬丁若動起官心，前者輸来更得勝，後者贏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"来便不贏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支相尅為飛敵，葉馬丁官心動摇，更变輸贏難㝎天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531712164233216"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連年詞訟未經决，𨚫似相持蚌与鷸。當宜推之再過爭，宜逺，就","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近豈知識","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𱖚氏改下二句云：尚且推之再過年，移逺就近，識意較醒，宜知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太嵗𤼵用為年，如子年発用，而丑寅、卯連去，為鷸蟬相持，連年不决，不可以近日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言之。如子年発用，而传入寅卯作月建，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以年之連茹者，則徔月論，又不可讑其通年也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土入木鄕爭田宅，忌見朱勾并賊劫。詳后。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土入木鄉，帯朱勾刼杀克干，主争田宅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土加水上争田宅。吏神直符臨其䖏，詳級","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直符：正戍二丑三辰四来切子六夘七午，八壬九亥，十寅十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一巳，十二申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531819672453160"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戍天吏守官符，帶憂争讼入牢獄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戍為羅網牢獄神，帶夫吏官符，主争訟牢獄之灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申臨寅卯有玄符，口舌文状主不寧。寅旺官符，又見傷老，争","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讼競財傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申臨寅夘𱖚克木也。若帯官符，主有口舌文状之事。寅為老。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人旺則将衰，又見𡨋符作鬼剋干，主老人争才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥上官符不見金，田宅相争外人分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥為用，見寅為破𢃄官符，傳中不是𱖚生，必有外人争田產","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囚脱訟釋目皇書。德竒儀解，赦詔除","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531743629721610"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上讼遇皇書，天詔、天赦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三竒六儀天解，主囚脫訟釋罪。赦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三竒。甲子戌句丑、甲申午，旬子、甲辰寅，旬亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六儀甲午、乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳、丙辰、丁卯、戊寅、己丑、庚未、辛申、壬酉癸戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"解神正二申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三日酉七六戌七八亥，九十子十一亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土入木鄉争田宅，朱雀官汙来和。辰卯加丑上又剋干，破碎和","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨田宅。干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土受木剋，田宅不安。弟雀官符破碎和臨，田宅争讼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木土官符災入獄，𬮦鎖二神常自逐。水上土下帯争風，田宅不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安訟和攻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木加圡上𢃄官符関鎖牢獄灾。水上土下帶朱雀官符王田","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531812613570600"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅和，争訟也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木金口舌看相臨，破耗□財劫争起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木相加，主口舌，帶破碎二耗，主口舌破才。若𢃄劫煞，勾陳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囙口舌争讼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未作勾争田宅官符。刑害空和逐，血光卻入蒿矢𱖚波。公廷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見訟神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蒿矢見𱖚𠔃之血。勾陳二獄，主刑獄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"血支正丑顺十二，血忌正丑二未，三寅四申，五邜𡖋酉，七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰八戌，九巳十亥、十一午十二子。天獄春子夏卯，秋午冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，地獄，春辰夏午，秋戌冬子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531819672485928"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支鬼刑干人不安，災生祸発惹驚官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支上作鬼刑干是宅不■容人帶二獄天吏主灾祸官非事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅立有符旺身合多鬚為吏争和涉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅發用乗旺，或合干克支，必主多須之吏来争。以用传言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴亥争田，官符出病符阴，小灾生異","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"贵人乗亥克干第官符，主争田宅，帯病符隂小有災。貴戌官符不可親，逢生舊事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再还来。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"贵人臨戍為履獄，主贵人嗔怒。干貴不見，问訟有忌。若有贵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"传生带官符，主𦾔事再發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人臨未貴人抝，只要奉承心不懊。慎口不争言，奉官一定罪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531819672502312"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青都。不判","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未主隂而抝性。贵臨未，貴性抝也。得此課奉承上官，得其懽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心，而可無罪也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人官符末刻干，吏官一㝎訟遭官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用乗贵人，帯官符，天吏来剋日干，有争讼之应。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人争讼無明白，不如捨弃歸家去。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴人履獄，主争讼不明，不如㱕上家不争。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇辰官吏為田園，憂哭昏沈不安哭，原本作灾，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蛇乗辰上剋干，帶官符、獄吏，主争田園，𢃄憂哭、病符、死張，主昏沈灾病。憂是憂神，灾即灾煞。金氏云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一本作哭神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531848105574463"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虵夘賊鹭見盗神，病煞女人災祸至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇加謂上剋干，𢃄盗神，主盗鹭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶病符女，既主女人灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇戌挟仇争死丧，𡨋符刑害入官方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌𢙣人，蛇加之，又加劫杀刑害，必是挟仇而争，死丧人家之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財物。若帶官好，主斗打入官方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱寅官符有官訟，若入病符籌火灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅発用乗朱，𢃄官符，主皮訟；帶病符火鬼，主火灾火鬼。□","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午夏落，秋子冬夘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱辰官訟見官符，或者吏神至上呼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神乗朱，帶官符，天吏主𡨋訟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531812613619752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱已病符湏見病，官符口舌和争論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳発用乗朱雀，帯病符，主病，帯官符主官訟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱寅𡨋符官訟顯，皇詔文書喜信臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅為吏，為衙门旺，乗朱帶官符克干，主有吏人讼，又為文官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如克干，帶旺和時，帯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"皇㤙天诏有朝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廷喜信。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子官符争必生，病符心痛事無成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用子乗朱，若𢃄官符主争讼，𢃄病符主心痛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳乗卯，加在鹿上，有関神，主訟争。德喜加应有解，终乆不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和訟不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰加在邜，是𢙣人臨门，更有関吏二獄，有訟争，見德喜解神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531886781202495"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"终久不成訟也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾為羅纲訟和侵，若入空亡有半鷺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾帯羅網，主争訟，若入空亡，則有形無寔，故半鹭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾丁作鬼，入于纲羅引子不慎，沈淪獄窝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闻勾剋干，帯丁神，二獄羅纲，尤為利害，否則淪獄不出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾白入辰又見吏，必目争詔入公庭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吏即天吏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳天牢煞并見，一定牢死家不見，又加羅網在其中。死炁和","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄人有難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳用剋千又常天牢羅纲煞、羊刃死炁，主牢死，一有不全，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可言死。天宇正丑順十二，地網正酉或辰，三午四未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531840891371529"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五子六丑，七寅、八亥，九邜、十戌，十一巳，十二申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳又見二獄神，更加直符走紛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"紛湏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/HRBJ0022/7436643931426848777/1-1741536647218.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=NEEkXTcnIWmPP0ECJl%2FHY1H24uw%3D","uri":"read/HY6380/5/ref/1kve9t23ndogq/1-1741536647218.webp","fontType":3,"components":"","variants":"臾","charPicId":"7479840703154733091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有卒來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"提捉，驚怕之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時莫出門。上勾下水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰方刑害田宅和争惶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用勾帯獄神，直符有卒來提捉。又水乗辰用見勾加刑害，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"争田宅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅夘辰乗上有勾，官災門打事無休。勾連訟獄胥符會，当有非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾牢獄愁。勾陳加吏獄，主争鬥官灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"争詔中间争剥貴，雖欲求饒沒奈何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爭讼中見二貴，則讼必經二貴。人问","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劫殺刑傷告，貴人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"々々。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反把我末嗔。不如歸避他方去，免得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531819672518696"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今朝自有刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用帶劫殺、刑傷剋貴，取貴之怒，貴由是嗔。我宜避迯免旤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詔乗劫煞最堪憂，克我難畄頭上頭。人可預逃方上𥡷，免得公","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"差下捉收。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用天詔乘劫殺、羊刃𣈆干，是朝廷賜死之詔，乗太歳尤的。月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"省曰府，時縣㝎之，無救則逃不得免。若有救并末传有生意","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"并旺和，逺遁可免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堂堂天詔出天門，雀使云云逐馬奔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上見君皇加寵贈，官上加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官榮上榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用亥為天門，加天詔，禄馬、朱雀𫝊見太歲月日時生干，主封","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531812613636136"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"贈加官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皇㤙天詔天龍戰，必有两官和剥弹。奏對君王分可否，受剋之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人對理難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"邜日占用夘，壬日占用壬。又人年立卯酉，用起邜酉上神，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍戰若用上帶皇恩天詔，必有兩官剥弹之事。其辨勝負，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何者剋他，何者旺和而剋人，勝他理直","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火金徳合得平和，其人如玉堪愛多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄金卯木哭憂會官符陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"私口舌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"多囚忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與辰，纲羅二獄又同臨，囹圄不乆相纏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"繞，悔之不及泪徒零。旺鬼加之主訟氣。官与直好用上行，務宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謹慎免人侵。不見其輸不見贏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531731466256447"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"峕當訟神，家有訟刑。更有官符，仇悔不定刑。登明勾帶朱官、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直符二獄，更臨囚死，必有官司。鬼𢃄飛符，身犯二獄，之子不慎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如何不哭？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛符甲乙申，丙丁亥，戊巳末，庚辛戌，壬癸辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午作官符，加吉神，詔儀又入禄馬臨朱動輕浮為嵗贵，士子曾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"将此捨名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用午作官符，上加吉神詔像。祿馬又臨米雀，岁貴訟不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳臨邜加在辰，墓门坎塜煞和臨，不是争坟人不足，就是争","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田價不明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰為墓，帯墓门、墳塚煞，帯死氣是坟，生氣是田。勾臨邜加辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531886781218879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是六害刻干，主争田㦯坟事。墓鬥正亥逆四孟，三坟即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三邱，五墓即哭神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳牢煞若併見，一定牢死家不見〇。騎虎而行，進必思却。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅為干加寅作馬是也，又被刑帶煞，主有凶，不可進也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"騎馬而進，退而心安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午為馬，干上加午，必欲求進，𨚫又与支宅作三六合，是忘家","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。強行不安，必中途而回，不去為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一牛二鬼，東赱西起。課中𱖚鬼，雖他為財，若非吉将，病哭訟来。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"課中無財，不能化為鬼。鬼多不止，哭泣病訟立見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"后合出門女見悲，必有陰私人自欺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531908696457231"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天后六合臨亥，加邜酉上来剋千，或刑害，干支帶哭神、憂神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主出门見女，悲也。传入太隂，是其悲也，必見阴私之人和欺，豈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徒悲哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憂神□丑夏子，秋戍冬亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬如𢅛，有事如風，速来速徃，不落沉濛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用日馬帯飛，兼是有馬如龍，帯刼殺，是有事如風。事既來速，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬又催行，必有速事而速成也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬不行，诸事宜停。子每前徃，諸叓不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬主動，落空則馬不行。入虵被纏有阻，所事不成。宜止。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行不可行，任不可住，忽然而徃，忽然而至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此反吟課，帯馬冲破，是不可行；既冲則止，又動不安，是不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531811179003930"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"住。忽徃忽来，心与事俱無定主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午子相掩看加煞，有影無形事還発。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反吟招冲掩，若再入空，凡事有影无形。若更生氣旺切，其事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初不成而後発。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三頭两靣，一鬼出廻，上不為嗟，下不為嘆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如火日干亥加邜為三頭鬼，巳加酉為四面鬼，一鬼剋干，出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"現餘鬼，乃传中鬼自和剋。如上剋下，損才不損人，不足為憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下剋上，則傷長人。百雷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天空，凡事皆為虗意指其事都不實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天空乃虗詐之不實，神主虚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得賊被逃，得物被逰，作事不成，有害不实","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"難可隠匿物則可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531848105623615"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難提。又越。官星伏吟，求名不成。天空入空，枉用其心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用傳官星，上乗天空，虗名不成。若乗吉神不空，則有可望。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官尅年神，被人騙，必有破耗飛和見休囚，方有旺和無，口裏無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言心裏恋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上神是我一年所轉之事，空破耗殺作用尅之，主破才事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若行年休囚，竒應旺和則無，雖騙不能言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空剋年神带丁馬，奴婢小人怨慱寡，必須逃走随別人，一例應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"防情意假此，如婢怨主而处。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天空負喜来生合，其年奴婢必添丁。天空発用併旬空，無形無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"影事沉蒙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531886781251647"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁巳日作天空，吏符和見訟灾凶。不見公门人有讼，公門口","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌已成空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎行年上乘劫，大旤滅门羊刃發，必有杀傷啚賴人，豫防豫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"備免曺法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白坐年辰欲出行，忽入空亾行不成。不帯丁馬游煞准，若帯游","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神要涡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白扁旺鬼吏関官符，必有争讼與人作仇。吏神刑害，作我官符","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎乗旺，鬼并诸煞，必有官符争訟。白虎乗午最不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堪，必知論語事和干。二獄網羅官訟発，名罪应","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知在禁閒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531731466305599"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太常貴人飛合生，徳禄馬喜又和并。迩来定作朝廷用，不是區","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"區红庶人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用乗常贵，与年上生合，又帯生氣䓁吉，或季命上神帶禄馬德神，必非凡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人常作官星合比日功名是也。若蒿矢見申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作用常与禄加午，午為紅心，巳弓申箭中武舉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常尅行爭苇破神，必有争奪財親事。預防不測免其傷，當与則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□免悔失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄剋行年入五盗，又乗诸煞來和照内，必有賊耒害我，夜急防","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之免賊耗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄剋行年帶和負，迷神，更𠔥謾语轉，欲過東號欲過西，無依必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531743629754378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有隂害謗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年神受元武所生，又入徳神并喜合，旺則進人口，衰則進田","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"產，其年不可言福久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元加刑害与官吏，仍為争讼事北利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見井煞與水憂，湏防溺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死無奔投。井煞正未順十二，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂剋行年帶咸池，刼人和累事无疑，㦯東或北人还西，必㝎隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謀要慎之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天后生年𧺫劫神，㦯為喜合轉和親，此旹必有婚和配，𭑰婢其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間一路尋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"后剋行年帯好门，传中又見害和刑，必有奸慱□争鬥，累死人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531731466321983"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家又至貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰后臨酉加扵丁，莫説有財彼婦爭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皇皇天使传命勑，竟本下□加赴職。小人不用不須求，君子逄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之方有益。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用乘貴為天使，帯皇书天詔，生支旺相，是朝𢌜，勅命加官君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子有，賢才吉小人㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴逑常，年命最良，意在求舉，皇出降祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星帯贵龍常在年命上，与用干支生比，無刑冲剋破害，空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帯皇書，与年命合吉，求名大利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人丑未下乗馬，吉神徳禄和扶持，皇㤙天詔在其中，苛苛功","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531908696506383"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名人仰視。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未得貴人之位，用传帯吉神良将功名必显。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䝿午德詔名徴書，官有陞擢遮𪠥資。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午為文書作用，上乗貴帯㤙詔皇書，干支年比合，官遷陞。民","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴旺，皇恩徳喜扶，定有恩榮。官吏吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用貴得旺和，并皇書徳喜，主貴升遷。若帯吉神，失時為吏，異","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨅌功名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴帯天詔，刑害自形，于此宜謹，免扵命殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用貴帯天詔，有下須之恩，又𢃄二死刑害剋干，若旺相生炁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531819672551464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㦯有譴責而可防。如干臨囚死，不免命殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官貪可嘱，貪賄不足，被民所傷，舎而歸俗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用官加休囚死绝之位，传入太陰、六合、元武臨財生官，是官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪財受賄。如下剋上，𢃄謾语天祸，又來入支，必被民告囬家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有使和催莫便行。詔書雖列未為榮。己宜謹守山林𨼆，可伴漁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"樵遇此生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用䝿天诏皇書有使催我為官中变二死刑害剋干，則吉中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有祸，宐𨼆不可去。用官見祿馬、贵朱無刑剋冲破為吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人產幙，晝夜兼是，意互功名，遐迩瞻仰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴三竒発用，皇書天詔，顯赫当时。帯诸吉星。用貴德禄不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531848105639999"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是常人，必為科甲，髙見王侯。帯印禄馬，皇恩天诏求官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇□德喜，官貴可擬，尤帯吉星，主当要𨅌。貴乗丑未，有鬼為魁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"课得元首作麥，德馬鑄印𢅛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"徳，太隂功名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唾手爭得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"騰蛇加壬，大小月煞，口舌和臨，無时可罷。朱雀门前，早晚嚼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嚼。尔有佳音，官人升爵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀臨卯酉，為门前也。干若旺和，用官帯喜花德禄馬天詔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主高遷，帯信馬主有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"信𢃄友符，主口。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官朱用貴亥與刑，此身争訟入公庭。直苻乗朱來剋支，更兼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"関獄两和拘。家门不幸遭人侮，文状交争見上司。用主作児因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囚禁，無救淹纏即脫身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀旺官吏関，官符来剋日辰，必有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531908696539151"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訟事。朱會","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官符并歲刑，羅纲却主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"須㒷六合之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申官符獄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羅網捕賊盗逃亾。勾陳臨寅作内戰，必因鬥打争和辨。勾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳空亡，官無訟凶。在外莫見，在後莫容。勾陳生年神進田宅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"関讼不宜作鬼刑。又加朱白勾陳生来尅身，心有缧泄，見子如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何淂太平。〇门火寅辰𬮦闭入，亦知獄中并之血。勾戌刑害是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"争墳，或有死屍作崇鷺。勺陳有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"■墓登","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墳塻煞和侵攬玄魂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不乆劫家病灾起，合人自在䘮其身。门神在丑，又乗破碎，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因墓破，湏興修置。〇。龍官年陳两相金，儀合徳禄又加爭。又是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尋常人作孽，此身應是㮄中人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用乗龍官与年命合，主貴常同。龍旺生干，皇書天詔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁馬主陞官職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531908696555535"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍剋行年用喜破，不過破財并大，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690877924229131/1-b5d24f5c0883e22c.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=GeWyQ75BE0xNyJiVkTcxJW9DK1s%3D","uri":"read/HY2948/2/ref/1ks259ujau2vg/1-b5d24f5c0883e22c.webp","fontType":1,"components":"鬲旡","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690877924229131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爭親争產及和磨，只宜謹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慎無差錯。〇惟木作鬼，二血帯死，嗚呼龍虎扶杖而死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531886781300799"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時為干支禄馬，𢃄諸吉神貴旺生干支，貴賤不同，而求名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"異扵各欲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一看干為己身，要旺招，不受刑剋冲破空為吉，其中末传有刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲克破，初傳則不為忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二看用末有旺和，与干年命和生比合，不犯所忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三看帯祿馬、天詔、皇書等吉；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四看太歳、月建曰時作用，帯禄馬、官貴等吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初居干前，末居干後，末居干前，初居干後，前引後從，或夹禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬貴等吉星。癸丑日邜巳未未，有鬼入丁，又𠔥二貴入传，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主貴人提携，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"成名辰□。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入水是双𮧻入海。一乗旺不空主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531908696588303"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中。一加空亡主不中。貴𮸲常三贵人带日孟，作馬中髙魁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴入寅無空剋，作官星，必顯贵。入墓止有皇㤙詔，虚名不显。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若貴人不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"入傳所乗，神生𢅛常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入传，主合干，又帯吉神，為官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長乆。丑常入武作官星，帶德诏中魁解，常戌如之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁巳日作天空，皇詔相逢喜氣農。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有旺初加立内，不日功","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名達九重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴馬在干前為用合干，貴人引我早早任馬官星是功名。有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入空亾，伏吟一时不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁馬迢迢被索□，空中徒自重加鞭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不玄不来，不自閑仔日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢到九天詔書，入空，一時不発。午丁生干即發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531858297684008"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論課名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入不入叓最急。課例先以克為傳，其事有應，亦来之意。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元首上克，始入重審，下克，始入比用、涉害、返吟、伏吟，皆自克","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而生，故谓之入。占得此者，十有九應，故為最急。如遥剋𭥦星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"别責入專，反吟、伏吟，不自克而入，皆謂之不入。其吉凶之叓，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應騐稍遲，亦不全应，故云云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"課得元首，事可永久，𠁽事顺利，庶可長久。顺其分而定守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，順其執而推行之，人心自服，可以長守富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故雖遇凶，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畏名利而不敢犯。故元首課占人品，為貴為尊，为君、為父為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長。占人事為尊貴，占物為頭上物，并貴重物。占功名為魁首，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531848105689151"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行兵主尊制，昇貴役賤。占詔支者，勝事起，男子臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"忠子孝𭂫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事，皆顺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"课淂重審，凡事宜謹。凡事以下犯上，則自取不正，人淂議","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，故凶多吉少。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占者須自量其力，自審其勢，不可肆志。得天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時之旺，天助也；得地利之和，地助也。得衆傳生助，人助也。自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得吉。天時不旺和，地利不和平，傳課不生助，則力孤勢索，所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行不正，自取其敗。占人品，為臣子妻孥，為民，為賤子逆臣，乗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事起女人奴害主。占人事下犯上，賤凌貴。占","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禽獸只。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"趾頭上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其下反生。占物件以下制上，足上頭下，先顺后反。占功名次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榜而改上，副官而權正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531731466387519"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時日剋干，天網自張；墓網加干，自取其旤。出克入刻，賁育難当。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前空後鬼，進退不得。知淂比用，免得人美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽日陽比，陰日陰比，発用凡人，一人一事，我可以和制，須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謹和防，慫事美成，其凶不大。上下有二三日克，是其人参差","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不一，必審匈者可依，何者可憎，𢙣者去之，譱者依之。能依則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同心共事，能玄則不歼施其奸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占者湏審何人何姓，何方何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，目所喜而從之居之，寧有祸哉？若占人品，為朋友、足弟為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同事、同學藝，官為同僚。占人事為兩事，為同謀。占物為鉗剪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文椅等件。占飛禽為鴛鸯，支為狼狽，植為連理，潜為比目。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知得涉害，所事不敗。不知渉害，為害必大。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531731466403903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛日用日上神，桑日用辰上神，涉害深浅。論地盤孟仲季㝎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，在孟事多反復，在仲季進退不定，凡事交害而有可比。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是我有賴，故彼此交加，必審害我者孰輊孰重，輕者来遅曷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支，重者来速為殃。輕者缓之，重者防之，其祸弭矣。占人品為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仇、为故、為賊、吕事，為争、為害，為劈侮，為侵凌，為賊虐。占草木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為荊棘，飲食為毒藥，在禽獸為鷹蝎、虎粮、蛇鴆，在物件為刀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"槍、枷杻類詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有千𱖚謝，不教作彈射曰：遙克神，名彈射。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙逆治","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則父子不親，順治君臣猜嫌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"客不可苗口。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌起西與，事主揺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動，人慱倒置。用傳帯土，為有丸，亦能傷人，無土灾輕，憂事立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531848105721919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散。見太隂、元武、天空，当有欺謾虗誕事，祸起扵内。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第四課発","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用無力，行兵不利，主利先動，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死與不死，要明。蒿矢神遥刻曰上下刻併，涉害反吟剋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入最急，有害心置死之道焉。蒿矢不入，為後有時發祸，其重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者每亦置人於死。占者湏辨何輕得生，何重罹旤，此課主外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人侵害，占人為丸、為賊，人事为乱，物件为枷鈕、趙索，禽为啄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木、鴟梟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成不成看昴星四魂無剋，五遙陽日取仰視，酉上神为初","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"传，支上神為中傳，日上神为末傳。隂日取俯視，酉下神为初","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"传，干上神为中傳，支上神必末傳。昴星雖不入，而事之成敗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531886781317183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比𫠦入者尤急，不子不慎。如柔曰昴，雖有吉者，而憂惧常𠔥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楚日昴出行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"常急占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人品，主外人㦯来人，占人事，㦯外事牽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惹。占物如铁爐箱類。剛日名虎視，轉蓬，宜防暗𠰌驚憂，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亾，災輕。忌子午邜壬日值此，舉動稽留，在外，難扵進止，逺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行東禁，恐死他鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

eIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇。别責，言借人以善事，占者當仗人以行，庶㡬無祸。占人事，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為人私幹，占物為牽連，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"课見反吟，先破後成，有丁巳辛■，玄傳不同，為井欄射丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日斜冲巳，七上見亥，以亥为初傳，中取辰，末取日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

ull},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆日上；柔曰從苐三课，逆数三辰之地，盤上何神為用，中末","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆日上，四課不全不偹□薄，男女混𣛜，見后合、勾武，主叔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531848105754687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嫂通奸，見妹淫亂。上下混則乱，人事混則壅，家不治，人不治。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斵輪申加夘発用，君子得之，有乗車之显，庶人淂之，則為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囚車髙盖。乗軒子邜乗天馬青常，君子为章服，庶人為䘮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"服。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鑄印戌加巳発用，君子懸金印，庶民則为假印服。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶用貴賤而生可否，以尊㫒而定君民，不爭槩論。若值空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，乗軒落馬，吉課入空，巳仕者有阻，未仕者不可攀，吉课失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，已仕者将停，未仕者不百進，加凶丧而帯丁馬，立逺竄。加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丧吊而帯病符，主丁憂。克太𡻕，为天子不容，害月建，为上司弹劾。〇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重審下剋上凶将為下民之反告，財神作脫，为賊賍之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敗亾。细玩自見，豈可以官得民之數，敬以为吉，而概不之皃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531840891404297"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不論官庶，時逄富貴，将淂時臨，平民得志。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙乘旺，和臨日辰，天以富贵多賤與人，數固己㝎，多賤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有時，而富贵，亦天意也。数故有寂，民可用同者，如富貴、時泰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"等卦是也。官淂而吉，民淂而亦吉，主平民受封，有吉無凶，官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"民同用。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三光、三陽，三竒、六儀，凶者化吉，吉者愈新。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"line neId":"1511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣣔謁尊官何䖏期。寸龍小吉子投依，斗罡加孟𫠦求獲，臨季空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囘仲许","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見六合、太常並周，如日之辰，刑害神将，不吉旡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人慱虚實，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼有使來知偽真。加持光看日兼辰。辰上之神傷日上，来者言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詞不妄陳。日为來使，辰为我在，若傷支是妄囙。隂空蛇虎魁罡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"立在日上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切者和逢必誑人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若報凶事，視白虎与今日比合，即是寔。若報吉事，視吉尤与今日比合，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是寔也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占遷官附求官遂否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文視青龍武視常，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"与日神和生吉，和剋凶。神将外戰在官憂罪累；内戰，主官憂疾病。測之口文官視龍三月甲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"成曰：未時占辰卯寅用午加辰乗尼，与今日和生为吉。遷甲至辰，青九得三位，即为三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"
