","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690878204215335/1-8d7180a9137f55fd.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=7kxetnzCz%2FF10w6VZJJBU9ZAjRI%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0628/2/ref/1lg47xvgjupkw/1-8d7180a9137f55fd.webp","fontType":1,"components":"戈山","variants":"武","charPicId":"7456690878204215335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"期。從成至辰，吉龍得七位，為七月期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531811179102234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此曰青龍乘午火，火生土，是戈巳為日期青。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"时旺和去三年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"七月，戊巳，日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰时","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遷武官，視太龍加女辰，則為辰常亦如之文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官去占寅乗青龍，寅属木，木生扵亥，至十月始遷。武官專占，子乘太常，子属水，水生子申，至七月始遷。餘倣此。馬折足龍化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇最不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"附求官遂否，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲卜求官成不成，湏逢印绶馬和并。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"魁常為印，授馬即天馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍常天后居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傳内，城吏太陰居顯榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傳送为天城，功曺為天吏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㝎文武附，擇日上官赴任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文武位殊占各别。文要青龍武太常。曰辰若内生其将，此選居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官得久長。上克下為憂罪累，下賊上时遭疾殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍常雨臨藏，上下和克賊也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日去就常遷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限，辰至龍常月可量。二将和生為上曰，時郎克","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531819672617000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍為共詳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"註悮前遷官下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"附擇日上官赴任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擇日上官任所徔，年上神𮞸官尅凶。兵法二曹金是主任，曹為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木水司工。禮属火官倉任土，水來傷火害期冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水官主事，行年上神，或彼官剋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主冬有灾及。将是朱禽憂口舌，神為白角病𢅛鍾。年上又遥能，天将言之上神剋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上官日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690877924229131/1-b5d24f5c0883e22c.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=WsmZjrFPA0tKnL%2F2CRiIhHBlgSo%3D","uri":"read/HY2948/2/ref/1ks259ujau2vg/1-b5d24f5c0883e22c.webp","fontType":1,"components":"鬲旡","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690877924229131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年上阴神所合制日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"值此之时。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"為月，假如甲乙日上官，年上見传送。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"传送本位登明々々合寅，寅為月建，建正月有凶，又剋其氖神，明神在庚，庚属水，当戊巳日有祸。餘仿比㝎曰以測。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門上傷年歸未得，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"任官之方為门，门上神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"剋年上神，是未歸本鄉上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷門搖役踪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"被差。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求替支傷干吉允斗，正加季也和容","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"擇上官日，勿令人年上神丸，拜署之日，又所出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"门不子充，人年上神，恐不得歸鄉也。𫠦出之门者，所徃之之方也。假令人年見徔魁，所徃之方，是西北戍地，上淂勝光，此謂門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531866136887307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上克行年也，年上神亦萬要克所往之门，上神主搖役不安之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"催官使者赴官期，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占上皮赴任，見曰：鬼乗白虎加日干，或年命上，名催官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"使者慫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是逺缺必催速赴任也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如使值空亡，又是虚信，或被避差。又如関星臨日干年命之上，其三傳上神生其官星者，亦名催官符。如六䖏見父母爻者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"便為㤙主、舉主之為食禄之地，出值長生貴人亦妙。假如六乙日見旦貴，六己日用夜貴，忌乙邜日贵空外，有四時返本。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞占赴任極遲也。查返本煞黄得金局，夏得水局，秋得火局，冬得土局，赴任占得反吟，多不滿任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占赴舉，内附殿試，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斥占科舉，以夜贵為簾幙貴人，以朱雀为文字，雀乗神旺招吊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日，如生文字合格，雀乗休囚，与日和克，傳空，必不合格。簾幙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官者，書店以夜贵是，夜占以晝貴是。此神臨人爭命之上，或臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰十者，試必中髙甲。或用六甲旬首，臨年𠇮日干之工，作簾幕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531743629852682"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官者尤的。惟大辛日、己日、乙日有之。又如甲辰、甲戌二旬中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占，淂辰㦯戍臨年𠇮日干者，必作魁元；或丑加未，或未加丑，作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年𠇮日干者，亦作魁元。绿丑中有头","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未中，有鬼斗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼二字，合而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為魁故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或天盤酉臨年命日干者，占試必作亞魁録酉為慫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁故也。已上諸说，皆忌空亾。日徳加亥为用，主人髙中。縁德","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入天門，德者得也。占赴殿試。如六巳日扵辰戌丑未年占，用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夜贵人逆布，乃真雀臨午，名真朱雀，其父得上意，必得髙中。縁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀生太嵗，又生日干也。如真朱尅太歲，占訟達朝廷，罪必跋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，惟中壬嵗然。占試如逢朱雀所乗之神尅簾幙官者，文不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帖主司意，㮄将出，忌朱雀臨丁馬。假如申年已将己巳曰子時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531908696702991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占，三傳己戍外課名鑄印乗軒，又曰龍徳卦，又係甲子旬首，子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加未上，却以旦貴为簾幙官臨身。且占人本命乙巳，其行年本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命上又乗神魁，占試中魁甲無疑。此例如無官人占試則淂經。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幙周全如有官人見之，則無不仕之官。雖值㢘幙官者，猶分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜忌。细具天後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日不喜未，庚日不喜丑，墓也。又甲寅日亦不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜空丑為之。庚寅曰之未同。六丙日并丁邜日不喜剋咬為之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳𡖉。乙亥曰不喜空申為之。六壬、六癸日不喜脱邜为之。壬寅、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸邜日不喜空巳為之。六辛日不喜剋午为之；辛亥日不喜空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅为之，空亾尤甚。試官不視其文卷，徒勞一次。如占武舉試","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弓箭，以巳为弓，申為矢，申加午，必箭中红心。如申加寅申己亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531848105820223"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為日脚花，以第四課言其箭數，其中四墓必脫垛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卷历八占求婚成否：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡上求婚成不成，湏逢天后莫和刑。曰：辰上淂凶神将剋下如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何合聘名。天后畏干女不肖，支克天后男悔慱。斗罡加季催花","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭，加孟禮函徒自營。加仲许之為配偶，媒看六合辨其慱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下無和剋，天后和生便合親。不然支波上神尅干，又尅制此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神明。传中六合吉𢅛在，陰阳有氣好婚𭑰。夫之本命加女𠇮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"两家年上看邪正，若是魁罡有損傷，大小吉號尤多病，雖遇𢙣神成不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怡，兩家年上吉招催。忽然和喜還中吉，若也和嗔不用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為。〇擇媍以㞐方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531840891437065"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲娶三方為女兒，辰申与午各和推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一女在辰，一女則在申，一女午地方上有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神知善惡，天后相生即可為。八月邜時甲子日，子乗天后與誰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天后属水，看午上土与。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"任方相生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰上火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午上是土剋天后，辰，工䖏是畏天两火后。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和剋，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫娶劍。申上從魁金水會，此女為妻是合儀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占女邪正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從魁太冲与亥末為用之時并太阴玄合𢘻為皆不正，若非無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色即邪淫。天上甲來臨子上，功曺加戍兩夫心。神后䖏伊年𠇮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上，採桒逢客必售金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

d":"1669","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午上是土剋天后，辰，工䖏是畏天两火后。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和剋，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫娶之。申上從魁金水會，此女為妻是合儀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占女邪正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從魁太沖与亥末，為用之時并太阴，玄合𢘻為皆不正，若非無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色即邪淫。天上甲未臨子上，功曺加戍兩夫心神后䖏伊年𠇮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上採桒逢客必售金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占女美醜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二后課時如旺和比妨輕盈貌並仙。居在凶神又囚死，媒人说","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531908696735759"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好是虗言。斗罡加孟当居長，仲即为中季少年。年上見金应白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色，火来臨焰必紅顔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木青，水黑，土黄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人入門吉㐫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦入門来任否臧，止於天后以居詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"tex {"lines":[{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷殘日本公姑疾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如壬癸日火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"為天后傷申金，若𱖚是水之父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋青龙婿必尪。六合畏之男女少，丑午遭刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛馬殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑克丑，损牛，刑剋午，損馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占任時来。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男以龍之阴為来年，女以后之阴為來年。大吉臨下辰為嫁。月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"后合占婚，豈用媒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占産育。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531811179151386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"罡为天后加年上，合主傷胎善護持。國值時傷憂更禹，支是母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多干是児，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凣時傷天后大㐫。假令六月辛未日申時，午將加申此為傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旹与干也，干為子，支為母，被騰虵臨至癸酉日，子死母腹傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支傷害母干傷子，蛇虎刑并𠇮必危。旺和吉神居此上，子母俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歡不要疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又看三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"传神將决","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六合青龍喜氣随，行年子上每刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害，便是平安信言知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占懷孕生時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人懷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孕無多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時未辨𫠦懷雄上雌。正時仰看母之命，更看行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531743629885450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年支上推。隂神本言生女子，陽神必㝎是男兜。再用勝光推產","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月，以臨之𠁅莫無移。又将月将以加時，丨与日號比不比。比即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是男應不妄，不比是女亦無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲子日占孕，時在午兴必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是男，未時直欲当生女。未于甲號為不比，斗罡加孟胎猶未，慫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"值生時亦主難。臨仲而今生巳近，加季便生如等閒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竒偶天罡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以繫辰，与日比陽男子身。比隂是女言非謬，不比難產恐鷺人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上日上同为决，俱隂是女不虗陳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俱陽是用男。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽剋下生男孔，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣前人嘗告郡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四月辛巳曰子時，課上勝光剋下，范蠡斷越王生男，果然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日罡臨寅邜，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是比陽，若臨子亥為比氤。凡罡与","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日同䫫曰氜，与支同𩔗曰阴。如罡加申酉，乃是不比，主難産，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531819672649768"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢干为兒，千受傷故也。若臨四季，亦是不比，主難產，恐損母，盖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支為母，支受傷故也。若罡臨巳午，亦是不比，却主生男。盖巳午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆属火，乃甲之子孫故也。雖難産而子母俱安，绿天罡𫠦繋切","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支干俱無和剋也。餘㫮仿此。如甲寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日干支同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類仔辨，以天罡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨寅生男，臨卯生女，□","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以寅为","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯為偶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不此依前法取之乚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又法，传陽生男，传隂生女，如臨産，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：占得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛日昴星生女，柔日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎視生男，取俛仰之義。凢日干之胎神作日之妻財，又逢月内","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之生炁者，占妻必懷孕。支之胎神作月内生炁尤的，不必干財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。惟此胎神臨妻，年命更好，或臨支。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"切亦同妻𬺱作，生炁不□胎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神亦可用，内有六辛、六癸、六己日乗胎神生𪸓，乃妻之妺，有孕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531907505291327"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尤騐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又辛癸日乗玄，有私。外有甲乙曰胎神在酉，如十月占，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是婢妾有孕。丙丁日胎神在子，如正月占亦然。又甲乙丙丁四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千胎神作空，乘死氣，必是鬼胎。胎神作空受剋，占産当日便生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刦細你月猒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"□占產必速，如六月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占巳加母年命是也。死爲作月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厭，占產必匈。如三月占申加母年命是也。六合三月上加申，四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月占加酉，乃月之死氣剋六合，至産期憂子凶。天后十一月占","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加辰，廿月占加戌，八月占加丑，二月上加未，乃月内死氣剋天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"后，到産期憂母凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢支加干，干加支，互和生者，名子恋母腹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"利占孕，不利占産。如至産期占之，主遲生則吉。六丙、六丁、六戊、六己日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎神充子，養神在丑，如在正月占，绿血支血忌皆在丑，併","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531840891469833"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"養神而剋胎神，占産必生速，㦯占孕有損。如十二月占，绿血支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"血忌皆立子作胎神，占産亦生速。如占孕亦防損。胎神臨本，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及臨绝受尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬卪午加亥，六庚日𡖉加夷，乃胎臨本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日如占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"産子言本日便是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日午加亥，六辛日𡖉加电，乃胎神臨絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受剋，占孕占產俱畏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六戊、六甲日子加巳時，占產稍不畏也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母之年命上神冲剋胎神者，嵷作生炁，必是小産，此肉極吟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁戊巳日子加申，庚申日卯加亥，壬癸日午加寅，甲乙日酉加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，大宜占孕。因胎坐長生之上，瓦惟占産反凶。腹加胎神丑爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日丑加酉，丙丁戊巳日丑加子，庚辛日丑加邜，戊巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日丑加午，如值此■來意，占妻有孕，因胎在腹内故也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531886781382719"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天盤之丑作旬空，占産必生■速。因腹空，必巳誕其子，占孕必損。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支干全傷，子母俱凶羯支受傷害母，獨干受傷害子。如小産，取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破胎之日必生，玄刑胎之日生，㦯月内生炁之日生，或以子息","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻之長生日生玄以子臨養䖏生。假今甲乙日以戍為養神，玄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以逐季屁天喜神所臨之日生，天喜者，乃逐季之養神也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占孕反損。又妻本命纳音之胎神冲破之日生，□騐支干夹三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傳，首尾六合，如占産，子母俱不子保，因氣塞拘中故也。若母之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年命透出支干之外，可免母匈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"産婦所向方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盆月功曹仲神后，委以天罡加建看，丙壬臨虔月爐地，産婦居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531811179167770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之得保安。又将傳送加年工，魁罡之下見傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占種田，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今𡻕營農问豐稔，五穀之神各數挨。木主禾苖金二麥，黍兼红","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荳火為之。丑未為麻皆属土，稲将里荳水言宜。四課三传有其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類，𡻕上之神和合宐。土併朱雀争疆界，亥子勾陳競水池。更将","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"室宿加寅上，宅長行年看所臨。傅送功曹為大熟，辰未必𮞸蟲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所侵。己亥收時對官讼，卯戍不收㦯還人。勝光熟與他人共，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然还債折資金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占養蚕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午為養蚕，未為桑，寅為繭子巳為筐，邜是絲𠔃辰是萵，申為绵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531858297847848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"絮壬為殭，子神鼠盗，亥當死，丑当眠。伏，戍為黄，传用凶神，知不保，吉将并之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飬即強。木为朱雀憂争茶，白序臨争人必尫。四课","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之中逢見馬，以馬三傳看否滅。岁上巳神允和合，欲得專。𢅛及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太常占奴婢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天空奴婢共为名，酉戍分占庶得精。何魁是奴徔魁婢。六合加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之欲𨼆形。合席并時憂疾病，吉神和拱保安身。不審行年求月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朔，朔上之神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"2008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸水神辰上停，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2009","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四日入墓申，水庫居辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉二支逢丑位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2011","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五支墓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合㝱魂鹭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2014","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六行年入墓：假如男行年立寅，功曺加戌，是寅午属火，火墓在戌位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帯殺虎并来入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，值此之时不恢迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎所乘兼旺和，逢剋行年必命傾，㐫期","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼日将愚准，甲乙占憂辛及庚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2019","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"瓦与死神俄剋行季，上神並凶，凶，以鬼日之之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑是墓田寅邜椁，浴盆加季四時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"终。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2024","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"谷盆煞，或辰、夏未，秋戌，冬丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡又主鍬鉏煞，■宿丧車不要逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2026","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𨋎宿，太乙，巳也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2027","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丧車亡未，二辰三丑日戌，逆日季。又云：□壬夏子，秋外冬午，四仲加人年𠇮凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毛頭本命加年上，与虎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2029","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531886781448255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作臨是大凶。虎與隂神傷病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2031","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日斥之阴神与白虎同克，起病日底，克今日支干者，必死矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼來追更□容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2034","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：天上死神臨墓，并行年及日辰上大凶。死神子，日在邜，順行十二辰，玄武臨浴盆，大凶為。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2035","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"浴盃見水，白虎隂神，自刻白虎所居神，病者必不死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病形状","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用金终，木𫝊流血，用木终，土痘腫疸，用水终，火寒執瘧，火午尫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瘦成瘡痍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土水淋漓并腹急，五行和刻逐慱推，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2040","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"比皆用起及傳终言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本𠇮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上神依類辨，如降子亥腎衰羸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2043","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水腎木肝土脾金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2045","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"肺各分主玄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬氣憂頻嘔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吐，干同虎類乆淹遲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2048","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"干与白，乖，比也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元武體虛為水疾，天空下痢更何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疑。□神乗魚虎，必是肝往受病，爭治肺而不可治肝。木神乗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎，必是脾經受病，可治肝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2052","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而不可治。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脾水乘虎，心经病，可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"治腎而不可治心。火神乗虎，肺經受病，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894739521572/1-619c975ca4508f88.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Z6B5OvRllG%2FwS%2F99OfQB6a2TMVo%3D","uri":"read/NCM011X411999016536/2/ref/1l5cwoly8q5ts/1-619c975ca4508f88.webp","fontType":1,"components":"治心","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690894739521572"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可治肺；土神乗虎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2057","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531831466803227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腎經受病，治脾不可治腎。巳上五法，常為的確有驗，惟俄受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刻及空亾，不必治之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占病。太乙騰虵主頭，二神俱是火𤆌上，旺則喘𠻳，衰則赤目，口","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌生瘡，頭痛、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2062","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠰸喉之疾。元武、登明俱是水洎下，旺主腹腎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之疾，哀则水逆，上主頭目眼疾，重則心疼也。天空臨戍，俱土罡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡖋然，旺則肺肝腰疼，衰則骨腿痛。勾陳在天秤，旺則刻水多，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"噎塞之疴。白虎臨傳送，旺則血流之灾，哀則皮膚瘡腫，筋骨傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"折。青龍臨功曹，主肝膽，旺則風疾，衰則損胃减會。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太冲六合胸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"膈疼，太陰從魁，主膓疼肺疾。天后在子，主男子腎病。太常在未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酒食蟲疾，嘔逆氣滯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2071","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531831466819611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占病專視日干之食。袖九妙行年乘之，乃名運粮神忌空也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又觀干之禄，何神不可落空亾，及作闭口成受刻。如占乆病，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"绝食而餓死。外有冬蛇掩目卦亦然。假如辛未日酉加寅，乃禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐绝郷，又作閉口，又名𤍍禄卦，問病必凶。天盤日之祿食作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空白，又坐刻方，占病必绝食而亡。假如甲辰句寅加壬，夜又乗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎，又反吟。乙巳日邜加申，夜又反吟；丁亥日午加亥夜，產申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日申加午晝，辛𡖉日壬加午夜，癸亥日子加未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2079","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加戌晝，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之食神，在禁方。又有禄神作闭叩，乘白虎都。假如乙未日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丣加由，又反唫夜，其反呤卦，乃岡干之禄受绝。丙戍以子巳為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閉中，辛未壬加戍夜，壬戍日亥為閉口禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2084","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531840891551753"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外宜觀生炁死氣尤騐。假如正月生氣在子，死氣在午，乃生炁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刳死氣也。如剋甲寅旬，占之，乃生氣空亾，死氣寔，占病𠂝畏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行年上神是亥水，尚爭毉治，縁亥水能刻午之死氣也，行年上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神反生其火氣者死。如生氣南死氣不和剋者，占病雖每□然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難痊。如白虎乗日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2091","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼作空亾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病必未瘥。外有日干之墓乗白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎在六䖏者，如占病必是積塊，病宜八破侵□治之。假如六乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日晝将順行，乃未乘白第，内乙壬日未空亾，無畏，或易療，非年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深積塊尔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日書蒋顺行，丑乗白虎，内辛壬日丑空亾，尔易","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"治。外有六庚、六辛日有白虎乗旬丁者，占病必重，以連疼痛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之𠁅。且如辛邜白灾加丑，作中𫝊畫占，乃亥乗白虎，作句丁神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2099","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531831466835995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必為頭痛，以殁不救。餘㸔丁虎乗類而言之。丑为脾疼，或腹疼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邜手疼，成目疼，戌足疼，巳齒疼，玄咽喉疼，未胃疼，㦯积瘕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉小","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹疼亥臨戌亥子丑寅卯为□，亥臨辰巳午未申壬為肾。餘逐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之如日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼臨在六□，不乘白虎，但擬其兔，亦為病症。假","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如火為鬼，便言肺病；水為鬼，便言心病；金為鬼，便■肝疾；土為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼，便言腎病；木為鬼，是脾病。如鬼受剋及空亾，不必療亦愈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如蒿矢刲，𡖋宜言有疼痛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2110","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"處金加火上，主筋骨痛，惟庚日申壬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加巳午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2112","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火的連茹卦作日之財，占病必因傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食而得。如命年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上神能制其財神，尚有医療。如命季上神反生其財，必死。斵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輪卦邜加申，戌加卯，占病必爭，足不舉，㦯有傷，占病見太隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2116","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531866136969227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍為殮日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外有六合加申臨死，謂之尸入棺。緣申本身也，扵三月之内，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是死氣，身即屍也。且上有六合，下有邜木，是棺也。尸入棺，占病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必死，尤宐詳其𩔖神言之。或申加卯，木乗六合，於九月占之，但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病左床而未愈。緣申是生氣，卯為木。未。癸卯日占父母長上病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死火急，縁父如及入棺故也。已上皆三月占火騐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690874177667091/1-779e1a63ad3b2db1.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=QehV3Dy6NrVToDI7lx5duydvULk%3D","uri":"read/NA09589/8/ref/1kpj0j1an5czw/1-779e1a63ad3b2db1.webp","fontType":1,"components":"六方","variants":"旁","charPicId":"7456690874177667091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"板。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外有申加巳，名白虎入丧車，発用為的，占病爭畏。如庚日㦯申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為木，𠇮反吟課，占病必死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"绿人入鬼門，又忌收䰟神，乃戊日辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲元武是也。夜順旦逆，有之，于十舟占动，緣辰為死𪸓尤的，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦忌浴盆有水浴盆杀□。辰順季位，其上忌乘亥子水，如天盤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2132","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531840891600905"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見欲盆，忌乘天𠔃玄武。如占小兒病死尤急。縁亥为孩子為子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"息，元武、天后即亥子巳午加亥子，寒熱患自，㦯剋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日主痨病。十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支吟，必主店滬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘有癸酉、癸丑、癸亥日，並支上未，作太常為用，應将有之。壬戌、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅、壬子日並支上未，亦作太常為用，夜貴有郎。以上六日例，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因未為太常剋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2140","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"干居扵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅上，或為溌用。如占病，必因喜事及飲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宴，或徃親戚家带病而歸，㦯是大官占之，必因赴宴得病。餘占皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囙前事而致不亥。內有壬子、癸丑二日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2144","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶旬丁在，必徃妻家得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病，極验。惟宐占人年命上有邜木為救，如乗寅木，必有神䕶，尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜命法官治动。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘稍後寅木反被未墓，難救矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2149","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531920834822184"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外有白馬乗病符剋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2151","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"干九：百畏或年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命，上乗血支血忌者，必是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"血症。玄女命占病，又帯月猒作血支血忌，必病血崩，或堕胎甚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"騐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覔毉藥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰月建同前之，此是天医對地医。今日支神同剋虎，当知减","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"退必無疑。醫神木土宜丸藥，水即湏湯火灸之。午為鍼從看其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類，勿用魁罡十喚師，制鬼之位是良醫。巳午作虎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2159","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜灸，申壬作虎鬼不宜針。假令乙丑日酉加干，乃日之鬼，𨚫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賴支上有午火克其酉𱖚，此午火，便是良医，㦯是本家親人能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毉，或得家尚神位保護，其餘可逐類而言之。又假令甲戌日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干上酉雖日鬼，奈是空亾不足畏，𠔥支上巳火坐扵墓七，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2164","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531858297897000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不能为救。似此一例求医，其医言病甚明，其如庸毉不能治","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"療。其餘救神不在支上，而臨三傳及年命，亦可為救。且如制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼之神，加亥子宜服湯藥；加寅邜并四土上，宜服丸藥；加巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午上，宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"灸加申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豆，宜針砭。医神所却为瘥期，所克为凶期，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃天地医也。天医作虎鬼不宜配，攻治庸良審二医。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰加行年于天上功曹下尋医，女以日加行年扵天上傳送","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下尋医。湏扵所值之䖏，視其神将吉者，方可用之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天毉曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月邜，二亥，三丑、四未、五巳，以此五神挨月臨之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：天医","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正邜之豬臨，三月随牛日未尋。切巳六夘北居亥八牛九羊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十巳直十一邜，两來尋邜十二亥卫作醫人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531840891617289"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看伊鬼為殃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"传中有虎傷本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2183","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日㸔是何神，作歌殃木主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絞刑脩造祟，金為傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼佛神堂。火并五道城隍灶，水則河神測北方。土祀宅神湏祭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祀，騰虵朱雀道中亡。虎為兵役勾陳吏，天后女姑為恠詳。貴人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神庙併先祖，親化只縁囙太常。传中逢是鬼，長生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2188","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己巳用木，传見金是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婆神五道祟分眀。沐欲淨官水神祸，冠帯宣修功德神，臨官說","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訟囙苗願。帝旺家支土地并，衰為木下山林鬼，病即湏酬小墓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靈。死墓光亾公伯祸，绝為流浪客傷畜，胎囙産死養神庙。此法","logicSentenceI Id":"2291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531907505438783"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"常長者家及隣家見□尤在長者玄寺觀見天后，在婦女贵人家見家寡家見贵人太常。在出入宫禁權将家見白□女丧媍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2293","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天空在奴婢人家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺和和生永不得，休囚欲走𬐔人拿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疑何人行盗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人在處好非求，而我亡財疑尔偷。且将太乙加季上，其次便","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㸔生月頭。虗星立子為真盗，参宿如臨莫陷尤。用神到此亦云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是，每此何湏结怨𬽦。欲知失物何人耶，陽是男人隂是女。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之与少看日辰。旺和休囚相類舉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2301","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"元武有氣少，名氣老。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其物，貴賤若伺知，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𬼘則專心尋。或時吉神幷者象家子，凶神臨者是負児。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占同房窃否，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一家之内十居一人失物九人吁，未知失者豈無𪞢，欲占先","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2306","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531942246711359"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以将加時。若有人季元武下，此人行盗㝎無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽照武宜擒賊。玄武坐扵太陽月将之上，占賊必敗绿。賊人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜画，可以隱形，豈宜被太陽之光照曜，以致賊形廻露。惟畏占","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時在夜，賊反𨼆也。尤宜逐季推尋，日出日入之時尤准。假如壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申日寅将申旹，乃反吟卦，且支上寅木，乃是日之盗炁，上又乗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元武，必是家中人作盗，後必敗露，因月將照破元武也。又假令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥日亥将戍時，干上亥是日之賊神，又乗玄武，初傳又是日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之墓神，中末寅邜爲日財，又是勾蛇，雖是太陽照武，戍時太阳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳歸埊下，其賊難獲。此例極多。餘倣此。又有元武雖不臨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太易之切，如加于邜辰、巳午未申天盤之上者，尚可捕捉。㦯元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2317","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531942246694975"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武臨天馬、六丁，更臨壬戌亥子丑寅之上，其賊終不敗露。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㦯傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年日底","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2321","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出有日八在尤賊人之類。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本家上乗太陽者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占盗立獲。如占失財，其財坐長生之上者，財终不致失。或所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失物類，其物坐長生之上，亦不失。又如戊寅日辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2327","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"将申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乗凶武，乃名太陽照武。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又乙未月壬将申時，□初傳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2331","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在末","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"传六己日，並酉将申時，又上己卯将申時。六癸日寅将申时，六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙曰酉将申時，乃臨年者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外有天䋄四張卦，占賊必獲，用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起并時，用剋曰千是也。臨破罔卦，占賊難獲，有神剋其初用者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。分有用神做賊者，例因元武所臨之神，有神作六合者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□□□□口□口子□丑子卜□□□□人□囗□有□賊不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2339","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531886642855945"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如趕賊者例。假如甲曰占，以申為賊，不可便以丙火去克，雖去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其鬼，賊亦窃其甲干，猶有所費，不如以壬水竊其申金，反生其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲干之木矣。又游都之下，捉賊必𫉬，甲己日丑，乙庚子、丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日寅，丁壬日巳，戊癸日申，元武加丁，主失脫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占行人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"思望行人久不歸，湏慿䫫神以推，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2346","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"〇䫫神如占奴視，天空涵魁之占婢裉，太隂終魁占僧視。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2347","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"传送太冲占道視功曺，■□，占婦女，視二日月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"后占六親，得我，為生我克我，我克之數門為𤼩限隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽二至算來期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"類神臨二至上立到子午為二至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2353","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"併南起酉為速，西将北轉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯非遲。假令行者身居戍，天魁臨亥绽装衣。仲名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"斗■。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道应和念，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉在東方寅卯维。午上功曹申和見，大吉当午巳合歸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531942246727743"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令占奴僕，視天魁，若魁加亥，其人必動，有歸意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如加寅邜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其人已在國，臨限午上為至期。戍若加寅午上，是功曺，其人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙寅邜到。戍若加外午上，是大吉，其人戊巳日歸。戍若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加午，其人当含回。乃曰臨限至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又取用神三合至子午干上相配之，應來必至日前亖前四上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神㸔是誰。若所占数神並不臨限至，難之。歸期，却取用神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合子午二到上，看有無决之。假令占文書，看朱雀乘寅加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌卦乃寅午戌，戌臨午上用神朱雀寅与戍合，为三合臨至当。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳日到也。若類神不臨限至，又不臨三合，㱕期亦難㝎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"却㸔支前四位。假令正月甲子日占淂邜時课，登毗臨邜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2372","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531942246744127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是支前课神，其人在𨅌。功曺加午在至，當甲巳寅邜曰㱕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𢦙不知方千里外，即視行年限度推。占人逺在千，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2376","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"里即㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其人行年臨䖏，若臨外酉限度，其人在𨅌，若臨子午二至之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卫，其人即到门也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又辨其人详物色，神将為名皆可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太常衣眼粮兼父，六合媒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人孫与兒。□龍朋友□夫壻，天后神后是妻姬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2382","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天后妻神后傴姬，原本作傴。按。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2383","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傴乃嫗字之悞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙太隂兄弟位，勾陳兵吏甲毛皮。天空酉戍雞奴婢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白序病人丧柩悲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元武隂私奸盗者，未禽官吏辨徵追。功曹狸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豹兼羽士，傳送刀兵僧与醫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太冲驢兎船車木，勝光獐鹿馬𠔥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2389","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7349531866137018379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麋，小吉雁鷹羊酒等，登明書易豕熊羆。此類𢘻皆求限至，課中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢𩔗到名疑。占存己逺近","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前述雖推限与期，存亾逺近未曾知。有人一玄無消息，乃課行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年㝎吉凶。年前寅申意不返，己亥本鄉心还念。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
